items.title: 晶片子公司告母公司！安世告上荷蘭法院 聞泰稱遭索賠20億美元
items.title_en: Chip Subsidiary Sues Parent! Nexperia Takes Case to Dutch Court, Wentech Claims $2 B Claim
paras: 荷蘭晶片商安世半導體周二(3日)宣布，已在荷蘭法院對中國母公司聞泰科技(600745-CN)及其創辦人張學政提起訴訟，要求賠償營運損失。安世並未在聲明中公布求償金額；聞泰則表示，安世要求被告合計賠償20億美元，聞泰對所有指控及求償要求均予以否認。
據《路透》報導，聞泰轉述安世荷蘭方面的主張指出，安世中國及安世上海違反與荷蘭公司簽訂的內部協議，應賠償相關損失。據聞泰說法，安世還指控被告在中國另建獨立供應鏈，干擾其營運，並與安世形成直接競爭，構成荷蘭法律所指的不公平商業行為。
安世在聲明中表示，被告的行為已對公司及業務造成重大損害，因此提告求償。聞泰則表示，目前尚未收到正式訴訟文書，法院也尚未受理此案；若法院受理並正式送達，將聘請海外律師應訴。
這場爭端可追溯至2025年9月。當時荷蘭政府介入安世半導體，表示目的是防止公司將業務移往中國。北京隨後一度禁止安世晶片出口。由於安世的晶片在中國東莞封裝，出口受阻一度導致汽車製造商面臨晶片短缺。
安世生產的基礎晶片廣泛用於汽車與消費電子產品。荷中兩國政府後來陸續撤回相關措施，車用晶片供應壓力隨之緩解，但安世在荷蘭與中國的業務至今仍處於分裂狀態。聞泰雖仍是安世的母公司，卻已因荷蘭法院裁定而失去對安世的控制權。
paras_en: Dutch chipmaker Nexperia Semiconductor announced on Tuesday (the 3rd) that it has filed a lawsuit in a Dutch court against its Chinese parent Wentech Technology (600745-CN) and its founder Zhang Xuezheng, seeking compensation for operational losses. Nexperia did not disclose the amount sought in its statement; Wentech says Nexperia is demanding a total of $2 billion in damages, which Wentech denies all allegations and claims.

According to Reuters, Wentech relayed Nexperia’s Dutch side’s claim that Nexperia China and Nexperia Shanghai violated internal agreements signed with the Dutch company and must compensate related losses. Wentech says Nexperia also accused the defendants of building an independent supply chain in China, disrupting its operations and directly competing with Nexperia, which constitutes unfair commercial conduct under Dutch law.

In its statement, Nexperia said the defendants’ actions have caused significant damage to the company and its business, prompting the lawsuit for compensation. Wentech said it has not yet received formal court documents and the case has not been taken up by the court; if the court does accept it and serve the papers, it will hire overseas counsel to respond.

The dispute dates back to September 2025, when the Dutch government intervened in Nexperia to prevent the company from moving its business to China. Beijing subsequently banned Nexperia chip exports for a time. Because Nexperia’s chips were packaged in Dongguan, China, the export blockage briefly caused a chip shortage for automobile manufacturers.

Nexperia’s base chips are widely used in automotive and consumer electronics. The Dutch and Chinese governments later rolled back the measures, easing pressure on automotive chip supply, but Nexperia’s operations in the Netherlands and China remain split. Although Wentech remains Nexperia’s parent, it has lost control of Nexperia following the Dutch court ruling.

items.title: AI會引爆下一場金融海嘯嗎？前紐約聯準銀行總裁點出關鍵差別
items.title_en: Will AI Trigger the Next Financial Tsunami? Former New York Fed President Highlights Key Differences
paras: 若目前規劃的AI基礎設施全數建成，總投資可能超過10兆美元。前紐約聯準銀行總裁杜德利(Bill Dudley)在《彭博》專欄指出，考量資料中心折舊速度，AI產業每年可能需要至少3兆美元營收，才能為這筆投資帶來足夠報酬。
他認為，熱潮退去可能引發股市大幅修正，但要演變成另一場2008年規模的金融危機，機率仍低。更難判斷的是，一旦資料中心賺不到預期的錢，損失最後會落在誰身上。

七八家搶當AI巨頭 最後可能只剩兩三家贏家

杜德利指出，目前至少有七、八家企業競相成為大型AI運算服務供應商，但最終勝出的可能只有兩、三家。如同雲端服務市場，業者規模愈大，愈能分攤成本，既有客戶與服務也有助於吸引更多用戶。問題在於，每家公司都是按自己有望勝出的前提興建資料中心，加總起來，整個產業就可能蓋得太多。
這場競賽的資金來源包括企業現金流、股票與債券發行、私人信貸，以及大型雲端業者和輝達(NVDA-US)等供應商對資料中心開發商提供的擔保。部分建設採租賃方式融資，相關義務要等資料中心完工後才會出現在資產負債表上。光看企業目前帳面上的負債，投資人很難判斷，一旦計畫生變，還有哪些公司有義務出錢。
輝達對晶片未來價值提供的擔保，就是一個例子。若晶片價格大跌，輝達本身的利潤率可能已遭壓縮，卻也可能恰好在此時必須履行擔保。換句話說，開發商最需要這項保障的時候，也可能正是擔保方最難承擔損失的時候。

AI投資若退潮 為何重演金融海嘯的機率仍低

儘管如此，杜德利認為，這波AI融資與金融海嘯前的房貸市場仍有重要差別。當年，許多投資人深信美國房價不會在全國同步下跌，也把獲評AAA級的房貸相關證券視為安全資產。金融機構又以短期借款持有難以迅速變現的長期資產，一旦貸款違約增加、短期資金無法續借，就只能低價拋售，讓資產價格進一步下跌。
如今，市場已普遍討論AI投資過熱的風險，而且多數融資期限較長，更符合資料中心的投資年限。保險公司等長期投資人較有能力等候回收資金，私募基金也往往可以限制投資人贖回，降低業者被迫在市場低點出售資產的可能性。
杜德利主張，監管重點應放在資訊較不透明的非銀行金融機構。他建議明確賦予證券主管機關維護金融穩定的職責，由銀行與證券監管機關共同釐清誰向誰借錢、誰提供擔保，以及什麼情況下必須付款。
他也呼籲檢討會計規範，讓企業更完整揭露已承擔的債務與可能觸發的付款義務。如此一來，投資人才能判斷自己承擔多少風險，以及拿到的報酬是否足以補償。
paras_en: If all planned AI infrastructure is built, total investment could exceed $10 trillion. Former New York Federal Reserve Bank president Bill Dudley noted in a Bloomberg column that, given data‑center depreciation rates, the AI industry may need at least $3 trillion in annual revenue to generate sufficient returns on that investment.

He believes the hype’s fade could spark a sharp stock‑market correction, but the odds of it escalating into a crisis on the scale of 2008 remain low. What’s harder to gauge is who ultimately bears the loss if data centers fail to earn the expected profits.

Seven or eight firms are scrambling to become major AI compute service providers, yet only two or three are likely to emerge as winners. As in the cloud market, larger players can spread costs, retain existing customers and services, and attract more users. The problem is each company builds data centers on the premise that it will win, so the industry as a whole may end up over‑building.

Funding for this race comes from corporate cash flow, equity and bond issuances, private credit, and guarantees from large cloud operators and suppliers such as Nvidia (NVDA-US) to data‑center developers. Some construction is financed through leasing, with related obligations appearing on the balance sheet only after the facilities are completed. Looking solely at companies’ current book‑level debt makes it hard for investors to tell which firms would still be on the hook if plans change.

Nvidia’s guarantee of future chip value is an example. If chip prices plunge, Nvidia’s own profit margins could be squeezed, yet it might be forced to honor the guarantee at that moment. In other words, the developer’s need for protection may coincide with the guarantor’s hardest loss‑bearing situation.

Even so, Dudley sees important differences between today’s AI financing and the pre‑crisis mortgage market. Back then, many investors were convinced U.S. home prices wouldn’t fall nationwide and treated AAA‑rated mortgage‑backed securities as safe assets. Financial institutions held illiquid long‑term assets funded by short‑term borrowing; when defaults rose and short‑term funding dried up, they were forced to sell assets at low prices, pushing prices down further.

Today the market widely discusses the risk of an AI investment bubble, and most financing terms are longer, matching the investment horizon of data centers. Long‑term investors such as insurers are better able to wait for returns, and private‑equity funds can often restrict redemptions, reducing the chance that operators must sell assets at market lows.

Dudley argues that regulatory focus should target non‑bank financial institutions that are less transparent. He recommends explicitly giving securities regulators a mandate to safeguard financial stability, with banks and securities supervisors jointly clarifying who borrows from whom, who provides guarantees, and under what conditions payments must be made.

He also calls for a review of accounting standards to require companies to fully disclose incurred debt and potential payment obligations, so investors can assess their risk exposure and determine whether returns adequately compensate for that risk.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉民主黨若拿下國會 哪些美股最敏感？華爾街點名四大類股
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections: Which U.S. Stocks Are Most Sensitive If Democrats Take Congress? Wall Street Highlights Four Key Sectors
paras: 美國期中選舉投票登場，部分民調與多數預測市場看好民主黨拿下參眾兩院，但華爾街的持股布局尚未充分反映這種結果。據《CNBC》報導，摩根大通估計，若民主黨全面掌控國會，標普500指數周三(4日)可能下跌約0.5%；若共和黨失去眾院、卻守住參院，指數反而有望上漲最多1%。對投資人而言，選舉結果不只牽動大盤，也可能改變AI、國防、醫療與金融股的走勢。

選後美股未必照慣例上漲 今年起點不同

選前民調顯示，民主黨有望奪下眾院，參院則勝負難料；預測市場更偏向民主黨包辦兩院。Wolfe Research美國政策與政治研究主管Tobin Marcus表示，該機構訪查逾百名機構投資人後發現，投資人雖已逐漸接受民主黨可能勝選，卻未明顯押注任何一種結果，部分原因是他們懷疑民調高估了民主黨的實力。
富國銀行投資研究所認為，若共和黨守住兩院，政策走向較容易預判，美股短線可望反彈。花旗則看好另一種結果：即使民主黨贏得眾院，只要共和黨保住參院，兩黨分掌國會也可能有利於美股年底行情。
歷史經驗對多頭有利。自1980年代初以來，每次期中選舉結束一年後，標普500指數都高於選舉時的水準。不過，BTIG首席技術分析師Jonathan Krinsky指出，歷來期中選舉年，標普500指數在下半年一度自高點回落的幅度平均達14%，選前走弱，才替11月反彈創造空間。今年標普500指數在投票前已累積兩位數漲幅，他因此認為，這次選後下跌的可能性反而較高。

AI股留意德州州長選情 醫療股看補助政策

近來AI股賣壓沉重，若民主黨在更多州取得執政權，投資人可能更擔心資料中心建設面臨限制。除了國會席次，Marcus也點名德州州長選舉。德州是美國資料中心建設重鎮，共和黨籍州長艾 Abbott若意外落敗，可能在短期內衝擊相關股票。高盛則認為，民主黨若掌控國會，可能縮減資料中心的租稅優惠，但無論選舉結果如何，全美暫停興建資料中心的機率都很低。
國防股與醫療股面對的政策前景也不同。富國銀行投資研究所分析師Alex Sagal指出，若民主黨大勝，扣除通膨後的國防支出成長空間可能受限，除非兩黨就同步增加國防與醫療經費達成協議。不過，他對國防業獲利的展望仍是持穩至溫和成長。

醫療股則可能受惠。Marcus預期，民主黨將爭取恢復《平價醫療法》已到期的加碼保費補助，並推動撤回部分針對聯邦醫療補助計畫(Medicaid)的改革。Argent Capital Management投資組合經理Jed Ellerbroek認為，近期醫療股走強，除了資金從AI股轉進，也有投資人在押注民主黨勝選。他關注的個股包括醫院營運商HCA Healthcare(HCA-US)、Tenet Healthcare(THC-US)，以及健康保險商聯合健康(UNH-US)與Centene(CNC-US)。

銀行留意信用卡利率上限 伊朗局勢牽動年底行情

金融股面對的變數，是川普年初曾要求國會將信用卡利率上限訂在10%。當時金融股一度成為標普500表現最差的類股，之後雖有回升，今年來漲幅約3%。Evercore ISI分析師Matthew Aks認為，若民主黨掌控至少一院，為了回應選民對生活成本的關切，可能再次推動信用卡利率上限，爭取川普支持。這也讓銀行業成為少數可能同時面臨兩黨政策壓力的產業。
選舉之外，美國是否在投票結束後擴大對伊朗的軍事行動，也是年底行情的一大變數。原油價格10月上漲逾10%，周一回吐不少漲幅。根據美國汽車協會(AAA)資料，截至周日，全美汽油均價仍達每加侖4.17美元，較去年同期高出近四成。若衝突升級，油價可能在感恩節出遊旺季前再度走高，能源股也可能因此優於大盤。
Evercore ISI提出的悲觀情境有兩項前提：民主黨拿下國會，而且川普在明年1月新一屆國會就任前擴大對伊朗的軍事行動。若兩者同時發生並推升油價，該機構估計，標普500指數到年底可能出現兩位數跌幅，下探6,800點。
paras_en: U.S. midterm elections are underway, and while many polls and most forecasts expect the Democratic Party to win both the House and the Senate, Wall Street’s portfolio allocations have not yet fully reflected that outcome. According to CNBC, JPMorgan estimates that if Democrats gain full control of Congress, the S&P 500 could fall about 0.5% on Wednesday (the 4th); if Republicans lose the House but hold the Senate, the index could instead rise up to 1%. For investors, the election result not only moves the broad market but could also shift the trajectories of AI, defense, healthcare and financial stocks.

Post‑election, U.S. equities may not follow the usual rally because this year’s starting point is different. Pre‑election polls show Democrats likely to capture the House, while the Senate remains uncertain; the market leans toward a Democratic sweep of both chambers. Wolfe Research’s head of U.S. policy and politics, Tobin Marcus, said that after surveying over a hundred institutional investors, they are gradually accepting a possible Democratic win but are not heavily betting on any outcome, partly because they doubt polls overstate Democratic strength.

Wells Fargo’s investment research believes that if Republicans retain both chambers, policy direction will be easier to predict and U.S. stocks could rebound in the short term. Citi, on the other hand, is bullish on a different scenario: even if Democrats win the House, as long as Republicans keep the Senate, a split Congress could still be favorable for the market’s year‑end performance.

Historical experience favors the bulls. Since the early 1980s, the S&P 500 has been higher a year after every midterm election than at election time. However, BTIG chief technical analyst Jonathan Krinsky notes that in past midterm years the index has fallen an average of 14% from its peak in the second half, weakening before the election and creating room for a November rebound. This year the S&P 500 had already logged double‑digit gains before voting, leading him to think a post‑election decline is more likely this time.

AI stocks have been under heavy selling pressure, and if Democrats take control of more states investors may worry about restrictions on data‑center construction. Marcus also singled out the Texas governor’s race. Texas is a hub for U.S. data centers, and a surprise loss by Republican Governor Greg Abbott could temporarily hit related stocks. Goldman Sachs thinks a Democratic‑controlled Congress might trim tax incentives for data centers, but regardless of the outcome the likelihood of a nationwide halt to data‑center builds remains low.

Defense and healthcare stocks face different policy outlooks. Wells Fargo analyst Alex Sagal says that a Democratic landslide could limit real‑after‑inflation growth in defense spending unless both parties agree to boost defense and healthcare budgets together. Nonetheless, he still expects defense earnings to grow modestly to steadily.

Healthcare stocks could benefit. Marcus expects Democrats to push to restore the expired premium subsidies under the Affordable Care Act and roll back parts of recent Medicaid reforms. Argent Capital Management portfolio manager Jed Ellerbroek notes that recent strength in healthcare stocks stems not only from funds rotating out of AI but also from investors betting on a Democratic win. He watches hospital operators HCA Healthcare (HCA‑US), Tenet Healthcare (THC‑US), and insurers UnitedHealth (UNH‑US) and Centene (CNC‑US).

Bank stocks are watching the credit‑card interest‑rate cap and the Iran situation as year‑end drivers. A variable for financials is that former President Trump earlier this year asked Congress to set a 10% ceiling on credit‑card rates. Financials briefly became the worst‑performing S&P 500 sector, later recovering and gaining about 3% this year. Evercore ISI analyst Matthew Aks says that if Democrats control at least one chamber, they may revive the cap to address voter concerns about living costs, courting Trump’s support. This makes banks one of the few sectors facing pressure from both parties.

Beyond the election, whether the U.S. expands military action against Iran after the vote is another year‑end market variable. Crude prices rose more than 10% in October before retreating on Monday. According to the American Automobile Association (AAA), as of Sunday the national average gasoline price was $4.17 per gallon, nearly 40% higher than a year ago. If the conflict escalates, oil could climb again before the Thanksgiving travel season, giving energy stocks an edge over the broader market.

Evercore ISI’s pessimistic scenario rests on two premises: Democrats win Congress and Trump expands military action against Iran before the new Congress convenes in January. If both occur and push oil higher, the firm estimates the S&P 500 could suffer a double‑digit decline by year‑end, slipping to around 6,800 points.

items.title: 9月飛機訂單大增近三成！美國工廠接單連三月成長
items.title_en: September Aircraft Orders Surge Nearly 30% as U.S. Factory Orders Grow for Third Consecutive Month
paras: 美國9月工廠訂單月增1.8%，優於市場預估的1.2%，連續第三個月成長。波動較大的民航機及零件訂單大增28.3%，是推升整體數據的主要動力。不過，即使扣除運輸設備，工廠訂單仍月增1.3%，機械、電腦與電子產品接單均有成長，顯示需求也延伸至航空業以外的製造部門。
美國商務部人口普查局周二(3日)公布，9月經季節調整後的工廠新訂單增加122億美元，達6,772億美元，8月增幅則由0.1%上修至0.3%。以未經季節調整的數據計算，9月訂單金額較去年同月增加約10.8%，今年前九個月累計較去年同期成長7.2%。
其中，耐久財訂單月增1.9%，高於初估的1.8%，以運輸設備訂單增加4.6%貢獻最大。相較於飛機訂單大增，汽車車身、零件及拖車訂單僅增加0.1%。其他產業方面，機械訂單月增1.5%，電腦與電子產品增加0.8%，電氣設備、家電及零組件則減少0.3%。非耐久財訂單也較前月增加1.8%。
企業設備投資也有回溫跡象。用來觀察企業設備支出計畫的核心資本財訂單，也就是扣除飛機的非國防資本財訂單，9月增幅由初估的0.5%上修至0.6%；這類設備的出貨額則月增1.2%，與初估一致。
據《路透》報導，AI基礎設施投資與強韌的消費支出，持續支撐美國製造業，該產業約占美國經濟的9.4%。不過，接單增加之際，業者對前景仍有顧慮。美國供應管理協會(ISM)周一公布的調查顯示，10月工廠生產強勁，但製造商信心持續惡化，業者點名價格波動、交期拉長、關稅，以及美國與以色列對伊朗的戰事，都是經營壓力來源。
經濟學家提醒，隨著利率走高，家庭所得扣除通膨後也在下滑，明年製造業活動可能放緩，尤其是較少受惠於AI投資的產業。
paras_en: U.S. factory orders rose 1.8% month‑over‑month in September, beating the market’s 1.2% forecast and marking a third straight month of growth. Orders for civil aircraft and parts, which are highly volatile, jumped 28.3%, driving the overall increase. Even after stripping out transportation equipment, factory orders were still up 1.3% month‑over‑month, with machinery, computer and electronic product orders all rising, indicating demand extending beyond the aviation sector into other manufacturing segments.

The U.S. Census Bureau of the Commerce Department announced on Tuesday (the 3rd) that seasonally adjusted new factory orders in September increased by $12.2 billion to $677.2 billion, with August’s growth revised from 0.1% to 0.3%. On a non‑seasonally adjusted basis, September’s order value was about 10.8% higher than the same month last year, and the cumulative total for the first nine months of this year was 7.2% above the comparable period a year earlier.

Durable‑goods orders rose 1.9% month‑over‑month, above the initial estimate of 1.8%, led by a 4.6% increase in transportation equipment orders. While aircraft orders surged, orders for automobile bodies, parts and trailers edged up only 0.1%. In other sectors, machinery orders grew 1.5%, computers and electronic products rose 0.8%, and electrical equipment, household appliances and components fell 0.3%. Non‑durable‑goods orders also rose 1.8% from the prior month.

Business equipment investment is showing signs of a rebound. Core capital‑goods orders – the metric used to gauge corporate equipment‑spending plans and which excludes aircraft and defense capital goods – were revised up to a 0.6% increase in September from the initial 0.5% estimate; shipments of this equipment class rose 1.2% month‑over‑month, in line with the original forecast.

According to Reuters, AI‑related infrastructure spending and resilient consumer demand continue to underpin U.S. manufacturing, which accounts for roughly 9.4% of the U.S. economy. However, despite the order uptick, firms remain cautious about the outlook. A survey released by the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) on Monday showed strong factory production in October, but manufacturer confidence kept deteriorating, with respondents citing price volatility, longer lead times, tariffs and the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran as sources of pressure.

Economists warn that as interest rates stay high, real household incomes are slipping after inflation, which could dampen manufacturing activity next year, especially in sectors that are less likely to benefit from AI investment.

items.title: 美股藏著「隱形熊市」？標普500距高點僅3% 六成成分股卻跌了至少兩成
items.title_en: Is a "Hidden Bear Market" Lurking in US Stocks? S&P 500 Only 3% From Its Peak, Yet 60% of Its Components Have Fallen At Least 20%
paras: 標普500指數距離歷史高點僅約3%，但高盛集團(GS-US)交易員Bobby Molavi指出，指數內已有六成成分股自各自高點下跌至少20%，進入熊市區間。他形容，美股正經歷一場「隱形熊市」。尤其令他意外的是，砸重金興建AI基礎設施的科技巨頭，與承接這些訂單的供應商，股價竟然一起下跌。
據《彭博》報導，主管高盛歐洲、中東與非洲交易執行業務的Molavi在客戶報告中指出，市場普遍仍相信AI將改變各行各業，卻同時下修買方與供應商的估值。自10月15日以來，美股「七巨頭」合計市值已蒸發4兆美元。在他的印象中，這是這些公司首度交出財報後，投資人仍普遍覺得成績不夠好。
不過，過去一個月，多數標普500成分股其實仍有上漲。這與六成個股身處熊市並不矛盾：前者看的是近一個月的漲跌，後者衡量的是股價距各自高點有多遠。隨著資金撤出原本集中的AI股，轉向防禦型類股及先前較少人持有的股票，部分個股雖然反彈，距高點仍遠。
這波資金輪動在上周四尤其明顯。當天，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)股價創20年來最大跌幅，單日市值蒸發5,000億美元，但醫療保健、房地產及民生必需品類股撐盤，標普500指數僅跌0.3%。晶片股承受的賣壓則重得多，費城半導體指數上周五收跌7%，一年來首度跌破200日均線，預估本益比降至約16倍，回到這波AI行情的低點附近。
Molavi認為，從最新財報來看，雲端需求依然強勁。Google Cloud營收翻倍，微軟(MSFT-US)旗下Azure成長48%，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下AWS營收也成長39%，創五年來最快增速。投資人真正想知道的是，科技巨頭還得花多少錢，以及這些投資要多久才能帶來回報。
據Molavi統計，四大科技業者合計創造的自由現金流只剩260億美元，遠低於以往水準。為了支應AI建設，企業除了動用手中現金，也愈來愈依賴發債與股權籌資。以亞馬遜為例，短短九個月，長期債務就從660億美元增至1,730億美元。Molavi認為，上周財報季顯示，市場對AI投資的評價標準已經改變：投資人更在意企業花出去的錢何時能賺回來。
在他眼中，債市傳出的警訊更值得留意。據其統計，自1996年以來，B級與信用評等更低的CCC級債券之間，殖利率差距達到8個百分點的情況不到五次。過去每次出現這個訊號，標普500指數當時都已較52周高點低至少11.5%，其中兩次更接近低了三成。這一次，在同樣的利差訊號出現時，標普500指數進入上周前距高點卻不到2%。
paras_en: The S&P 500 index is just about 3% shy of its historical high, but Goldman Sachs trader Bobby Molavi said that roughly 60% of its constituents have each dropped at least 20% from their own peaks, putting them in bear‑market territory. He described the US equity market as undergoing a "hidden bear market," noting that even the tech giants pouring massive capital into AI infrastructure and the suppliers fulfilling those orders have seen their shares fall together.

According to Bloomberg, Molavi, who heads Goldman’s Europe, Middle East and Africa trading execution business, wrote in a client report that the market still broadly believes AI will transform every industry, yet valuations for both buyers and suppliers have been trimmed. Since October 15, the combined market cap of the US “big‑seven” tech firms has evaporated $4 trillion. In his view, this is the first time after these companies reported earnings that investors generally felt the results were still underwhelming.

However, over the past month most S&P 500 components have actually risen. This does not contradict the fact that 60% of stocks are in a bear market: the former looks at one‑month price moves, while the latter measures how far a stock is from its own peak. As money has fled the once‑concentrated AI stocks and shifted toward defensive sectors and previously less‑held shares, some stocks have rebounded but remain far from their highs.

The rotation was especially evident last Thursday. On that day Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US), Google’s parent, posted its biggest one‑day drop in 20 years, wiping out $500 billion in market value, while healthcare, real estate and consumer‑staples stocks provided support and the S&P 500 fell only 0.3%. Semiconductor stocks faced far heavier selling; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 7% on Friday, breaking below its 200‑day moving average for the first time in a year and seeing its forward P/E fall to roughly 16×, back near the low point of the AI rally.

Molavi believes that, based on the latest earnings, cloud demand remains robust. Google Cloud revenue doubled, Microsoft’s Azure grew 48%, and Amazon’s AWS revenue rose 39%, the fastest five‑year pace. Investors really want to know how much more the tech giants will have to spend and how long it will take for those investments to pay off.

Molavi’s calculations show that the four major tech firms together generated only $26 billion of free cash flow, far below historic levels. To fund AI build‑outs, companies are not only tapping cash on hand but increasingly turning to debt and equity issuance. For Amazon, long‑term debt jumped from $66 billion to $173 billion in just nine months. Molavi says the latest earnings season indicates that the market’s criteria for valuing AI investment have shifted: investors care more about when the money spent will be earned back.

In his view, warning signs from the bond market deserve even more attention. Since 1996, the spread between B‑rated and lower‑rated CCC bonds has widened to 8 percentage points fewer than five times. Each time that signal appeared in the past, the S&P 500 was already at least 11.5% below its 52‑week high, with two instances seeing a drop of about 30%. This time, when the same spread signal emerged, the S&P 500 was less than 2% away from its recent peak.

items.title: Fed能鬆口氣了？美國9月職缺意外增至752.3萬個 創四個月新高
items.title_en: Can the Fed Breathe Easier? U.S. September Job Openings Unexpectedly Rise to 7.523 Million, a Four‑Month High
paras: 美國9月職缺意外增加33.3萬個，達752.3萬個，創四個月新高。企業實際聘僱人數也回升，裁員降至一年半來最低，主動離職人數則較上月增加逾一成。這些變化顯示，美國就業市場進入第四季前仍有韌性，讓聯準會(Fed)有空間繼續關注通膨。不過，9月非農就業人數僅增加2.9萬人，企業是否已開始加快擴編，仍待更多數據確認。

職缺超出市場預期 州與地方政府增幅突出

綜合外媒報導，美國勞工統計局周二(3日)公布職缺與勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)，9月底職缺高於《路透》調查預估的710萬個，也超過《彭博》調查中所有經濟學家的預測。8月職缺由707.9萬個上修至719萬個，9月職缺率則從4.3%升至4.5%。
從產業來看，光是州與地方政府，不含教育部門，就增加10.4萬個職缺。專業與商業服務、資訊、貿易與運輸、營建及製造業的職缺也增加。房地產、租賃與租借業職缺從前月的5.2萬個回升至7.5萬個，金融、民間教育與醫療服務等產業的職缺則減少。
Fed關注的勞動供需指標也略有回升。9月職缺比失業人數多出41.4萬個，高於8月的15.9萬個，相當於每名失業者平均對應約1.1個職缺，高於8月的約1個。相比之下，2022年企業搶人高峰時，每名失業者約有2個職缺可選，目前整體供需仍大致平衡。

主動離職人數月增逾一成 周五非農將見分曉

9月主動離職人數從304.4萬人增至336.5萬人，單月增加32.1萬人，增幅約10.5%。主動離職率升至2.1%，創逾一年新高。更多勞工願意離開原有職位，可能反映他們對找到下一份工作更有信心。其中，住宿與餐飲服務業人員流動尤其明顯，既是當月聘僱成長的主力，也有大批員工主動離職。
整體而言，9月企業實際聘僱人數增加13.1萬人，達540.2萬人，聘僱率從3.3%升至3.4%。同月裁員及解僱人數減少12.7萬人，降至164.1萬人，為2025年3月以來最低。經濟學家指出，內需穩健、企業獲利良好，有助於減少裁員，但物價高漲與中東戰事仍讓部分雇主對增聘人手保持謹慎。
這也解釋了為何9月職缺大增，非農就業人數卻僅增加2.9萬人：職缺反映月底尚待填補的職位，非農數據衡量的則是整體就業人數的淨變動。加上JOLTS調查回覆率已較疫情前下降，職缺與聘僱若能連續數月回升，才更能判斷企業是否正走出「少聘僱、少裁員」的狀態。
Fed在9月進行三年來首次升息後，上周維持利率不變，並表示就業成長與勞動力增幅大致相當，失業率變動不大。市場接下來將關注周五公布的10月非農就業報告。《路透》調查顯示，經濟學家預估新增就業人數將回升至6.5萬人，失業率則料持平於4.2%。
paras_en: U.S. job openings unexpectedly increased by 333,000 in September, reaching 7.523 million, a four‑month high. Actual hiring by firms also rebounded, layoffs fell to the lowest level in a year and a half, and quits rose by more than 10% from the prior month. These changes show that the U.S. labor market remains resilient heading into the fourth quarter, giving the Federal Reserve room to keep focusing on inflation. However, non‑farm payrolls grew by only 29,000 in September, so whether firms are truly accelerating hiring still requires more data.

Job openings exceeded market expectations, with state and local government leading the gains. According to a composite of foreign media reports, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released its Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on Tuesday (the 3rd). By the end of September, job openings were higher than Reuters’ forecast of 7.1 million and above the range predicted by Bloomberg’s poll of economists. August openings were revised up from 7.079 million to 7.19 million, and the September job‑opening rate rose from 4.3% to 4.5%.

By industry, state and local governments alone added 104,000 openings, not counting the education sector. Professional and business services, information, trade and transportation, construction and manufacturing also saw increases. Real estate, leasing and rental openings rose from 52,000 in the prior month to 75,000, while openings in finance, private education and health services fell.

The labor‑supply‑demand indicator that the Fed watches also ticked up slightly. In September, job openings exceeded the number of unemployed by 414,000, up from a surplus of 159,000 in August, meaning there were about 1.1 openings per unemployed worker, versus roughly one per worker in August. By contrast, at the peak of the 2022 hiring frenzy, each unemployed worker had about two openings to choose from, so overall supply‑demand remains roughly balanced.

Quitters rose by more than 10% month‑over‑month. In September, quits increased from 3.044 million to 3.365 million, a monthly rise of 321,000 or about 10.5%. The quit rate climbed to 2.1%, a new high in over a year. More workers are willing to leave their current jobs, likely reflecting greater confidence in finding new employment. Turnover was especially pronounced in the accommodation and food‑service sector, which also drove most of the month’s hiring growth while seeing a large number of workers voluntarily exit.

Overall, firms’ actual hiring in September rose by 131,000 to 5.402 million, lifting the hiring rate from 3.3% to 3.4%. Layoffs and discharges fell by 127,000 to 1.641 million, the lowest level since March 2025. Economists note that solid domestic demand and strong corporate profits help curb layoffs, though high inflation and Middle‑East conflicts keep some employers cautious about adding staff.

This helps explain why job openings surged while non‑farm payrolls grew by only 29,000: openings reflect positions that remain unfilled at month‑end, whereas the non‑farm figure measures the net change in total employment. Moreover, the JOLTS response rate has already fallen below pre‑pandemic levels. Only if openings and hiring continue to rise for several months can we tell whether firms are moving out of a “low‑hiring, low‑layoff” phase.

After the Fed’s first rate hike in three years in September, it kept rates steady last week and said employment growth and labor‑force gains were broadly in line, with little change in the unemployment rate. Markets will now focus on Friday’s release of the October non‑farm payroll report. Reuters’ poll shows economists expect job gains to rebound to 65,000 and the unemployment rate to hold steady at 4.2%.

items.title: 波灣產油國出口量重回戰前水準！沙國、阿聯等四國10月原油出口增至1553萬桶 有望牽制油價漲勢
paras: 中東主要阿拉伯產油國的原油出口量已恢復至與戰前大致相同的水準，從大量原油湧入全球市場來看，油價漲勢有望獲得控制。
根據彭博與能源分析公司彙整的油輪追蹤數據，沙烏地阿拉伯、阿拉伯聯合大公國(阿聯，UAE)、伊拉克與科威特10月原油出口量合計增加10%，達到每日1,553萬桶，大致回到今年初的水準。
相較之下，在美國海上封鎖下，伊朗原油出口已連續第二個月降至零。
波灣阿拉伯產油國的出口量再度回升，顯示油輪透過荷姆茲海峽秘密穿梭運輸的策略已見成效。這項做法最早由阿聯推行，近期沙國也開始採用。
這波出口復甦有助於維持實體原油市場供應充足，並在關鍵時刻緩和油價。汽油、柴油等燃料價格居高不下，正在擠壓消費者支出、加劇通膨升溫，也讓美國總統川普在期中選舉面臨政治風險。
最新一波出口增長的主要推手是沙國。從油輪追蹤、衛星影像及Kpler、Vortexa的數據來看，沙國10月原油出口量升至每日700萬桶，月增13%。
隨著華府與德黑蘭相繼釋出可能繼續尋求外交解決方案的訊號，原油期貨周一價格回落，但在市場仍擔心軍事衝突升級的情況下，油價仍有一定支撐，布蘭特原油期貨仍徘徊在每桶106美元附近。

沙國加快出口速度 紅海與波灣航線同步受惠

在衝突期間，沙國出口大多落後阿聯，直到9月沙國的替代性東西向輸油管線因一場攻擊短暫關閉之後，沙國才加快取道荷姆茲海峽的原油運輸。
如今由於東西向輸油管線恢復運作，沙國得以同時從傳統的波斯灣出口航線，以及繞行紅海的替代路線中受益。
10月增加的出口主要來自沙國紅海港口延布(Yanbu)，當地原油出口量大增35%，達每日307萬桶。
專家表示，由於許多油輪為避免被追蹤或遭到攻擊而關閉船舶定位訊號，目前油輪航運的可見度仍受限制，因此實際原油運輸量可能高於目前觀察到的數字。
伊拉克是上月出口增幅第二大的國家。數據顯示，伊拉克原油出口量增加9.5%，達每日335萬桶，逐漸接近戰前水準。出口增加主要來自南部巴斯拉港(Basrah)，以及經土耳其運往北方的航線，後者的運輸量幾乎翻倍。伊拉克上個月曾表示，原油出口量已接近戰前水準。
阿聯的出口量則小幅增加每日5萬桶，平均達每日374萬桶，創7月以來新高。阿聯比其他波灣國家更早在數月前推動出口量大幅回升。
國際能源總署(IEA)數據顯示，阿聯9月原油產量創下新高。阿聯能源部長Suhail Al Mazrouei周一(2日)在阿布達比一場會議上表示，衝突期間，該國原油出口量「在某些時候」已超越戰前水準，但未透露目前的具體出口量。
油輪追蹤與Kpler數據顯示，科威特10月出口量增加三分之一，達每日144萬桶，創戰爭爆發前以來最高水準。
科威特主要透過日益增加的油輪船隊運送原油，科威特國營石油公司上月已表示，出口量恢復至接近衝突前的水準。
除了追回戰爭期間流失的銷售量與營收，仍留在石油輸出國組織(OPEC)的三個波灣國家，可能還有額外誘因盡可能提高出口量，因為該組織成員正準備協商2027年的產量目標。

OPEC準備協商2027年產量配額 伊朗出口連續兩個月掛零

Real Macro執行長暨創辦人Jeff Currie表示，實體原油市場正反映能源市場已出現永久性的「結構性轉變」。
石油輸出國組織(OPEC)及其盟友正在檢視各成員國實際能夠生產的原油數量，並準備在11月29日部長級會議上調整產量配額。
另一方面，在美國持續實施海上封鎖之際，油輪追蹤數據連續第2個月未偵測到伊朗原油或凝析油出口。歐盟Sentinel 1與Sentinel 2衛星影像顯示，10月伊朗哈格島(Kharg Island)碼頭、以及索魯什(Soroosh)與賈斯克(Jask)出口碼頭，均未看見裝載活動。
值得注意的是，這些觀測結果可能並不完整，因為多數運載伊朗原油的油輪在波斯灣內航行時不會發送定位訊號，使追蹤這些船隻通過荷姆茲海峽的行蹤更加困難。

items.title: Meta為AI建設發債！美元債擬籌150億美元 首批歐元債最快周三登場
items.title_en: Meta builds bonds for AI! USD bond to raise $15 billion, first Euro bond as early as Wednesday
paras: 據《彭博》報導，臉書母公司Meta(META-US)已啟動跨幣別發債計畫，目標透過美元債籌集約150億美元，並預計最快周三(4日)首次發行歐元債。知情人士透露，Meta計劃合計籌資至少200億美元，最終規模仍可能視認購需求調高。
這是Meta相隔半年再度進入投資級債券市場。此次美元債分五批發行，期限從5年到30年不等，其中30年期債券的初步報價，較同天期美債殖利率高約2.5個百分點。Meta與負責承銷的花旗集團(C-US)、摩根士丹利(MS-US)均不予置評。
今年4月，Meta曾發債籌得250億美元，認購金額高峰達960億美元，接近發行規模的4倍。如今，大型科技公司相繼為AI基礎設施籌資，債券買家也開始要求更高的風險溢價，才願意承接新債。
光是本周一，甲骨文(ORCL-US)就發行了100億美元債券，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)也透過歐元債籌得60億歐元。微軟(MSFT-US)則在上周發債250億美元。《彭博》行業研究估計，其追蹤的大型雲端業者與專營AI運算的新興雲端公司，未來三年投資總額將逼近4.5兆美元。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, Facebook parent Meta (META-US) has launched a multi‑currency bond issuance program, aiming to raise about $15 billion through U.S. dollar bonds and planning to issue the first Euro bonds as early as Wednesday (the 4th). Sources said Meta intends to raise at least $20 billion in total, and the final size could be increased depending on demand.

This marks Meta’s return to the investment‑grade bond market after a six‑month hiatus. The U.S. dollar bonds will be issued in five tranches with maturities ranging from 5 to 30 years, and the preliminary price for the 30‑year bond is about 2.5 percentage points higher than the comparable U.S. Treasury yield. Meta and the lead underwriters, Citigroup (C-US) and Morgan Stanley (MS-US), declined to comment.

In April this year, Meta issued bonds that raised $25 billion, with order books peaking at $96 billion, nearly four times the issuance size. Today, large tech firms are successively raising capital for AI infrastructure, and bond investors are demanding higher risk premiums before agreeing to take on new issues.

Just on Monday, Oracle (ORCL-US) issued $10 billion of bonds, and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) (GOOG-US) raised €6 billion through Euro bonds. Microsoft (MSFT-US) issued $25 billion of bonds last week. Bloomberg’s industry research estimates that the total investment by the large cloud providers it tracks and emerging cloud companies focused on AI computing will approach $4.5 trillion over the next three years.

items.title: 台積電25年供電長約待送審 Pinnacle West規劃1.88GW供電
items.title_en: TSMC's 25-Year Power Supply Contract Awaiting Review; Pinnacle West Plans 1.88 GW Supply
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國電力公司Pinnacle West Capital(PNW-US)表示，已於10月與台積電(2330-TW)簽訂25年直接定價供電合約，將供應亞利桑那州晶片製造園區全面建成後約1.88GW的用電需求。公司預計近日將合約送交監管機關審查，仍待核准。
Pinnacle West總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城，透過旗下子公司在州內供電，業務涵蓋發電、輸電與配電，旗下擁有核能、天然氣、燃煤及太陽能等發電設施，以及輸配電線路、變電站與儲能設備。
這是Pinnacle West首份直接定價合約。台積電將提前投入資金，並提供信用擔保，讓電力公司能配合園區用電需求，安排電源及電網建設。公司強調，相關投資成本將由台積電承擔，不會轉由住宅用戶負擔。
執行長Theodore Geisler表示，台積電這筆1.88GW需求，已計入公司目前合計5.8GW的已承諾用電需求，也納入長期電力資源規畫。若台積電未來進一步擴建，雙方將再討論新增用電的供應安排。
Geisler指出，公司新增用電需求來自多個產業，其中製造業的貢獻高於資料中心，包括晶片製造及其他製造業。與台積電簽訂的合約，也可作為日後服務其他大型客戶的參考，目前公司正與其他等待供電的客戶協商。
這類合約通常要求客戶支付預付款、提供擔保，並訂定最低用電量、用電容量及提前終止合約的責任，讓電力公司在投入建設前，取得客戶的長期承諾。不過，其他協商案能否簽約，目前仍未確定。
隨著用電需求增加，輸電設施也必須同步擴建。公司指出，目前服務區域的輸電系統已無多餘可用容量，新增發電資源必須搭配新的輸電設施，才能可靠地接入電網。依最新規畫，至2041年，客戶全年用電量預估將增至約80,600GWh，超過目前兩倍；未來15年規畫新增近15GW電力資源及約2.6GW輸電容量。

paras_en: On November 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. utility Pinnacle West Capital (PNW‑US) said it signed a 25‑year direct‑price power supply agreement with TSMC (2330‑TW) in October, to provide about 1.88 GW of electricity for the fully built chip‑manufacturing campus in Arizona. The company expects to submit the contract to regulators for approval in the near future, pending clearance.

Pinnacle West is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, and supplies power in the state through its subsidiaries. Its operations cover generation, transmission and distribution, with nuclear, natural‑gas, coal and solar generation assets, as well as transmission lines, substations and storage equipment.

This is Pinnacle West’s first direct‑price contract. TSMC will invest funds up front and provide credit guarantees so the utility can match the campus’s power needs and arrange generation and grid construction. The company stressed that the related investment costs will be borne by TSMC and will not be passed on to residential customers.

CEO Theodore Geisler said TSMC’s 1.88 GW demand has been added to the company’s currently pledged 5.8 GW of power commitments and is incorporated into its long‑term resource planning. If TSMC expands further in the future, the two parties will discuss additional supply arrangements.

Geisler noted that the new demand comes from multiple sectors, with manufacturing contributing more than data centers, including chip fabrication and other manufacturing. The contract with TSMC can serve as a reference for serving other large customers, and the company is currently negotiating with other clients awaiting power supply.

Such contracts typically require customers to pay advance payments, provide guarantees, and set minimum usage, capacity and early‑termination responsibilities, giving the utility a long‑term commitment before investing in construction. However, it remains uncertain whether other negotiated deals will be signed.

As power demand grows, transmission infrastructure must expand in tandem. The company said the existing transmission system in its service area has no spare capacity, so new generation must be paired with new transmission facilities to connect reliably to the grid. Under the latest plan, annual customer electricity consumption is projected to rise to about 80,600 GWh by 2041 – roughly double today – and the next 15 years will see the addition of nearly 15 GW of generation and about 2.6 GW of transmission capacity.

items.title: 矽晶圓漲價｜環球晶全尺寸接近滿載，第四季仍是舊價，2027年才是驗證點
items.title_en: Silicon Wafer Price Rise | GlobalWafers Near Full Capacity, Q4 Still at Old Prices, 2027 the Validation Point
paras: 2026年11月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 矽晶圓大廠環球晶(6488-TW)今（3）日宣布，董事會通過規劃發行最高5億美元、約新台幣160億元的私募可轉換公司債，由美國記憶體大廠美光Micron(MU-US)擔任唯一應募人，落實雙方7月宣布的策略資金合作，並強化美國在地矽晶圓供應。
這檔可轉債為無擔保債券，期限10年，票面年利率0.5%，仍須提交股東會決議。通過後，董事會可在決議日起一年內，視市場狀況與公司需求一次發行。
美光7月宣布投入最高30億美元強化美國半導體供應鏈，其中5億美元以策略資金支持環球晶美國德州Sherman廠的12吋矽晶圓產能，雙方也規劃簽訂10年供應協議。
既然已有10年長約，為何不採預付款，而要發可轉債？環球晶在今日法說會上說明，預付款通常直接連結未來的產品採購與交貨，這筆策略資金的用途更廣，除了支持供應關係，也涵蓋美國營運發展與供應能力提升。
環球晶表示，可轉債在發行時仍屬債務工具，與現金增資不同，不會立即增加普通股股數；公司可取得長天期資金，現金利息負擔也相對較低。董事長徐秀蘭指出，美光願意透過可轉債參與環球晶的長期發展，反映雙方多年累積的信任，以及對環球晶未來成長的信心。
環球晶美國德州廠的進度也在加快。公司指出，德州廠一期主要設備安裝大致完成，數家一線客戶已完成認證，月出貨量連續4個月創新高，洽談美國產能長約的客戶也持續增加。
徐秀蘭表示，半導體需求正在擴散，但合格產能無法一夕建立，新產能還要面對高額資本支出、設備交期與客戶認證。德州廠二期的建物與部分基礎設施已經到位，後續擴充的資本效率和速度都可望優於一期，但實際投資仍要視客戶承諾、獲利與政府支持而定。
財務方面，環球晶第三季營收149億元，季減2.3%，毛利率20%，每股純益3.13元；前三季每股純益15元，已逼近去年全年的15.29元。公司指出，營收下滑主要受7月義大利Novara廠火災影響，若沒有這起事件，單季營收可季增逾12%。
環球晶9月完成14億美元GDR發行，第三季底由第二季底的淨負債186億元轉為淨現金263億元，財務體質明顯改善。
展望後市，環球晶表示，扣除仍在放量的新產線，現有12吋產能已經滿載，8吋與6吋也接近滿載，預期2027年矽晶圓供需將比2026年更緊。徐秀蘭指出，第四季表現可望優於第三季，但多數訂單仍維持舊價；2027年第一季起，除了新產能陸續貢獻，平均售價也將優於今年第四季。
不過，漲價並非全面到位。徐秀蘭坦言，部分客戶手上晶圓庫存較多，對價格調漲態度較為強硬，公司將依產品規格、供需狀況、合約到期時間與個別客戶情況逐案協商。

paras_en: On November 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – GlobalWafers (6488-TW), a major silicon wafer manufacturer, announced today that its board approved a plan to issue up to US$500 million (about NT$16 billion) of private placement convertible bonds, with U.S. memory giant Micron (MU-US) as the sole subscriber, implementing the strategic capital cooperation announced in July and strengthening Micron’s local silicon wafer supply in the United States.

The convertible bond is an unsecured debt instrument with a 10‑year term and a 0.5% annual coupon, and still requires shareholder approval. Once approved, the board may issue the bonds within one year from the resolution date, depending on market conditions and company needs.

In July, Micron announced a maximum US$3 billion investment to bolster the U.S. semiconductor supply chain, of which US$500 million will be strategic capital to support GlobalWafers’ 12‑inch wafer capacity at its Sherman plant in Texas, and the two parties also plan to sign a 10‑year supply agreement.

Given the existing 10‑year contract, why not use advance payments instead of convertible bonds? GlobalWafers explained at today’s briefing that advance payments are usually tied directly to future product purchases and deliveries, whereas this strategic capital has broader uses, covering not only supply relationships but also U.S. operational development and capacity upgrades.

GlobalWafers said that convertible bonds remain debt instruments at issuance, unlike cash equity injections, and do not immediately increase the number of common shares; the company can obtain long‑term funding with relatively low cash interest costs. Chairperson Hsu Hsiu‑lan noted that Micron’s willingness to participate via convertible bonds reflects years of mutual trust and confidence in GlobalWafers’ future growth.

Progress at GlobalWafers’ Texas plant is accelerating. The company said Phase 1 equipment installation is largely complete, several Tier‑1 customers have finished qualification, monthly shipments have set new highs for four consecutive months, and negotiations for long‑term U.S. capacity contracts are increasing.

Hsu Hsiu‑lan said semiconductor demand is expanding, but qualified capacity cannot be built overnight; new capacity still faces high capital expenditures, equipment lead times, and customer qualification. Phase 2 building and some infrastructure are already in place, and the subsequent expansion’s capital efficiency and speed are expected to surpass Phase 1, though actual investment will depend on customer commitments, profitability, and government support.

Financially, GlobalWafers posted Q3 revenue of NT$14.9 billion, down 2.3% quarter‑over‑quarter, with a 20% gross margin and earnings per share of NT$3.13; earnings per share for the first three quarters total NT$15, approaching last year’s full‑year NT$15.29. The company said the revenue dip was mainly due to a fire at its Novara plant in Italy in July; without that incident, quarterly revenue would have risen over 12% YoY.

In September, GlobalWafers completed a US$1.4 billion GDR issuance, turning net debt of NT$18.6 billion at the end of Q2 into net cash of NT$26.3 billion by the end of Q3, markedly improving its financial health.

Looking ahead, GlobalWafers said that excluding new lines that are still ramping up, existing 12‑inch capacity is already fully utilized, and 8‑inch and 6‑inch lines are near full load, expecting wafer supply‑demand to be tighter in 2027 than in 2026. Hsu Hsiu‑lan noted Q4 performance should exceed Q3, but most orders will remain at old prices; from Q1 2027 onward, as new capacity comes online, average selling prices are expected to be higher than in Q4 2026.

However, price hikes are not universal. Hsu Hsiu‑lan admitted that some customers hold sizable wafer inventories and are resistant to price increases, so the company will negotiate case‑by‑case based on product specifications, supply‑demand balance, contract expiry, and individual customer situations.

items.title: 〈環宇法說〉環宇-KY前3季EPS達3.91元 Q4、明年成長動能續強
items.title_en: <Huan Yu Legal Commentary> Huan Yu-KY Q3 EPS Reaches NT$3.91; Q4 and Next Year Growth Momentum Remains Strong
paras: 三五族光通訊股環宇-KY(4991-TW)今(3)日舉行法說會，也公告今(2026)年第3季財報，受惠於自有品牌光電元件(AOC)出貨強勁回升，營收占比由61%躍升至71%，單季稅後純益1.59億元、季增44.5%，年增增逾10.3倍，EPS 1.33元，累計今年EPS為 3.91元。
環宇-KY今日舉行線上法說，第3季單季營收為8.45億元、季增9.7%、年增55.4%，主要受惠於AOC出貨量增；毛利率47%、季增3.7個百分點，與去年同期47.4%約持平；營益率19.3%，季增65.9%、年增56.1%；稅後淨利歸屬母公司1.59億元，累計前3季稅後純益4.65億元，EPS 3.91元，較去年淨損1.45元轉虧為盈。
環宇-KY總執行長暨總裁安寶信表示，獲利增加主要因AOC產品占比提升為71%，季增約10%不僅提高毛利率，也提升業績增長，同時在AI DC(資訊中心)需求，加上射頻元件的代工也帶動AOC的營收成長。
此外，安寶信指出，加上磷化銦(InP)基板與磊晶供應回穩，出貨量顯著增加，公司調漲AOC價格以反映原料成本上揚，且存貨跌價損失減少下，也挹注毛利率、RF晶圓代工營收則季減7.6%，光電晶圓代工營收季減37%，環宇-KY在策略上也調整接單，聚焦重要客戶訂單出貨。
展望未來，法人預估公司預估第4季營收3,000萬至3,400萬美元(約新台幣9.52億-10.79億元)，季增有望達到雙位數成長，毛利率維持46%至50%高檔，營業費用因CW Laser 開發進度遞延，相關攤銷費用預計自第4季開始認列，預期營業費用將提高至760萬至860萬美元。
安寶信表示，隨著AOC需求持續強勁，加上轉投資資威利富公司取得額外產能下，有望維持出貨產能強勁。在原料基板部分，環宇-KY預估磷化銦基板價格將持續上漲且供貨緊縮，受到美中政治性因素影響較大，公司目前與合作夥伴採取迅速出貨策略因應，2027年供應已透過長約鎖定，但2028年仍在協商。
另隨著Marvell收購光通訊大廠Lumentum，環宇-KY看好整體光通訊市場展望，目前在基板料件供貨無虞，預期可供至2027年出貨暢通，安寶信看好第4季與明(2027)年運營將持續向上成長。
法人表示，環宇-KY在今、明2年市場展望維持穩定成長看法不變，在200G PD產品線部分，也因非中國基板供應商產能風險較大，環宇-KY將導入第2家基板供貨來源，預計2027年第2季將能顯著放量成長，看好第4季與明年營運都會持續向上增長。
paras_en: Huan Yu-KY (4991‑TW), a leading optical communications stock, held a legal briefing today (the 3rd) and also released its Q3 2026 financial results. Benefiting from a strong rebound in shipments of its own‑brand optical‑electronic components (AOC), the share of revenue from AOC rose from 61% to 71%. Net profit after tax for the quarter was NT$159 million, up 44.5% quarter‑over‑quarter and more than 10.3‑fold year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$1.33. Cumulative EPS for the year now stands at NT$3.91.

In the online briefing, Huan Yu‑KY reported Q3 revenue of NT$845 million, a 9.7% quarterly increase and a 55.4% year‑over‑year rise, driven mainly by higher AOC shipments. Gross margin was 47%, up 3.7 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and roughly flat with the 47.4% recorded a year ago. Operating margin reached 19.3%, up 65.9% quarter‑over‑quarter and 56.1% year‑over‑year. Net profit attributable to the parent was NT$159 million, bringing cumulative net profit for the first three quarters to NT$465 million and EPS to NT$3.91, a turnaround from last year’s loss of NT$1.45 per share.

CEO and President An Baoxin said the profit increase was mainly due to the AOC product share climbing to 71%—about a 10% quarterly rise—which not only lifted gross margin but also boosted overall growth. In addition, rising demand for AI data‑center (DC) solutions and RF component foundry work also helped drive AOC revenue higher.

An also noted that, with indium‑phosphide (InP) substrates and epitaxial wafer supplies stabilizing, shipment volumes rose sharply. The company raised AOC prices to reflect higher raw‑material costs, and reduced inventory write‑downs, both of which supported gross margin. However, RF wafer foundry revenue fell 7.6% quarter‑over‑quarter and optoelectronic wafer foundry revenue dropped 37% quarter‑over‑quarter, prompting the company to adjust its order intake strategy and focus on shipments for key customers.

Looking ahead, analysts forecast Q4 revenue of US$30 million to US$34 million (approximately NT$952 million‑NT$1.079 billion), with the potential for double‑digit quarterly growth. Gross margin is expected to stay in a high range of 46%‑50%. Operating expenses will rise to US$7.6 million‑US$8.6 million as CW‑laser development costs are deferred and related amortization begins to be recognized starting in Q4.

An said that as AOC demand remains robust and the company’s investment in Zhiwei Lufu (a subsidiary) adds extra capacity, strong shipment volumes are likely to continue. Regarding substrate materials, Huan Yu‑KY expects indium‑phosphide substrate prices to keep climbing and supply to tighten, with significant impact from U.S.–China political factors. The firm is working with partners on a rapid‑shipment strategy; supply for 2027 has been locked in through long‑term contracts, while 2028 arrangements are still under negotiation.

With Marvell’s acquisition of major optical‑communications player Lumentum, Huan Yu‑KY is optimistic about the overall market outlook. Substrate material supply is secure through 2027, ensuring smooth shipments, and An is confident that both Q4 and 2027 operations will continue to grow.

Analysts maintain that Huan Yu‑KY’s market outlook for this year and next remains stable and growth‑oriented. For the 200G PD product line, because non‑China substrate suppliers carry higher capacity risk, the company will add a second substrate source, which is expected to enable a significant volume increase by Q2 2027. They are bullish that both Q4 and next year’s operations will keep rising.

items.title: 1條飄帶騙走百萬！政院急下架逾5千假帳號 揭應援小物圈套
items.title_en: A Ribbon Scam Swindles Millions! Executive Yuan Quickly Takes Down Over 5,000 Fake Accounts, Exposes Support Merchandise Trap
paras: 距離投票倒數25天，選情逐漸升溫，卻有歹徒利用民眾挺候選人的熱情發動詐騙。民眾在社群平台上索取1件應援飄帶，慘遭詐騙近100萬元。行政院打擊詐欺指揮中心特別呼籲，民眾在熱情應援時務必提高警覺，只要貼文出現+ LINE、私訊、賣貨便、全家好賣、實名認證失敗等關鍵字，都是典型的詐騙手段，切勿輕易落入歹徒的話術圈套。
行政院打詐中心與刑事局詐防中心自10月起加強執行候選人應援小物詐騙貼文蒐報作業，截至11月2日已封鎖下架5071個詐騙帳號及貼文，近期每日可封鎖下架近500個詐騙帳號。被詐騙集團冒用的候選人遍佈台北、桃園、新竹、台中、高雄等地。單是10月1日至11月1日，警察機關即受理相關詐欺報案70件，受害金額高達1500萬元以上。
打詐中心指出，目前發現被冒用的應援小物包括御守、安全帽、吊飾、茄芷袋、徽章、髮夾、圍巾、陽傘、風車、帆布袋、護腕、冰袖等30多種。詐騙手法與傳統演唱會應援詐騙如出一轍，歹徒宣稱免費提供小物，吸引民眾私訊或加LINE，再以支付運費為由誘騙至假賣貨便或假全家好賣網頁，最終以實名認證失敗或金流認證失敗等藉口拐騙財物。
行政院打詐中心提醒，民眾若欲領取應援小物，應前往競選總部等實體地點，或透過候選人官方網站與官方帳號查詢，切勿輕信來路不明的網路貼文。若貼文者帳號成立未滿3個月或顯示海外地區，極可能為詐騙帳號，民眾應立即向平台檢舉，共同築起防詐防線。
paras_en: With only 25 days left before the vote, the campaign is heating up, but criminals are exploiting the public’s enthusiasm for candidates to launch scams. People on social media requested a single support ribbon and ended up losing nearly NT$1 million to fraud. The Executive Yuan’s anti‑fraud command urges citizens to stay vigilant when showing support; any post that mentions “+ LINE”, private messages, “sell‑goods‑link”, “FamilyMart good‑sale”, or “real‑name verification failed” are classic scam cues and should not be taken at face value.

Since October, the Executive Yuan’s anti‑fraud center and the Criminal Investigation Bureau’s fraud‑prevention unit have stepped up monitoring of candidate‑support merchandise scam posts. By November 2 they had blocked and removed 5,071 fraudulent accounts and posts, and in recent days they are taking down about 500 fake accounts daily. The fraudulent groups are impersonating candidates across Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Taichung, Kaohsiung and other regions. From October 1 to November 1, police received 70 related fraud reports, with total losses exceeding NT$15 million.

The anti‑fraud center notes that more than 30 types of support items have been misused, including amulets, safety helmets, pendants, herbal bags, badges, hair clips, scarves, sun umbrellas, wind‑spinners, canvas bags, wrist guards, and ice sleeves. The scam method mirrors traditional concert‑support scams: perpetrators claim the items are free, lure victims to private‑message or add them on LINE, then request payment for shipping and direct them to fake e‑commerce pages or counterfeit “FamilyMart good‑sale” sites. Finally they cite “real‑name verification failed” or “payment verification failed” as excuses to steal the money.

The Executive Yuan’s anti‑fraud center advises anyone wishing to receive support merchandise to go to the campaign headquarters or other physical locations, or to verify through the candidate’s official website and official accounts. Do not trust obscure online posts. Accounts that are less than three months old or show an overseas location are highly likely to be fraudulent; users should report them to the platform immediately to help build a stronger anti‑fraud front.

items.title: 華新攜產業夥伴成立「華新世紀核能」布局新式核能 華新持股過半
items.title_en: Hua Xin Partners with Industry Players to Form "Hua Xin Century Nuclear" to Deploy Advanced Nuclear Power, Holding Majority Stake
paras: 華新(1605-TW)今(3)日指出，隨著AI快速發展帶動用電需求攀升，穩定供電與減碳已是各國能源政策重要課題，核能成為兼顧低碳及供電韌性的選項。為掌握全球核能產業發展契機，宣布攜手世紀能源(2072-TW)、高力(8996-TW)以及泰豐，共同成立「華新世紀核能系統股份有限公司」，今天進行簽約，共同布局核能產業。華新也補充，華新持股過半，未來將視營運狀況進行增資。
華新指出，華新世紀核能未來將整合各合作夥伴專業技術與產業資源，發揮彼此互補優勢，推動供應鏈協作發展，並積極拓展國內外市場機會。
華新表示，公司具備國際核能認證的材料能力及供應實績，將提供不銹鋼、鎳基合金材料、管材及核用電纜等材料；世紀能源擁有專業銲工團隊、廣大港區腹地及專用重件運輸碼頭，有利大型設備製造與出口，並同步導入德國萊因(TÜV Rheinland)提供的ASME核能設施組件製造認證與授權檢驗服務。
高力長期深耕熱傳、熱流技術，以及高溫、高壓環境下的熱管理技術，具備金屬加工、精密製造與銲接等核心能力，並累積能源發電系統及高階熱交換器產品的開發與製造經驗；泰豐則長期深耕能源相關產業市場，並積極參與核能產業。
華新表示，小型模組化反應器(SMR)及微型模組化反應器(MMR)等新興技術快速發展，核能供應鏈整合與在地化能力建構已成為發展趨勢。
有鑑於此，華新偕同可靠夥伴，共同打造核能產業鏈國家隊，藉由核能認證、材料供應經驗與實績，協助合資方與合資公司建立完整核能供應鏈認證，進一步整合產業鏈及供應能力。例如結合華新旗下英國子公司與航太及核能巨擘Rolls-Royce 合作經驗，建立 SMR/MMR 相關設備的製造、組裝及組件供應能力，以及與歐洲其他知名核能企業合作，長期供應歐洲核電廠的實績，進一步拓展國際核能產業發展機會。
華新表示，華新世紀核能成立後，將優先與政府主管機關、研究機構、產業協會及相關單位展開交流與溝通，推動核能產業發展及供應鏈協作。營運初期將以開發海外核能市場、支援國內既有核能設備與材料需求，以及推廣各合作夥伴既有產品與技術為主要方向。
未來則將持續結合各方資源，逐步發展核能設備及系統相關整合能力，透過國內外累積的核能經驗與研發，打造 MMR及 SMR 建構及組裝能力進軍國際，並為台灣預備未來新式小型核能反應器之製造能力。
華新董事長焦佑倫指出，台灣擁有完整的工業基礎與製造實力，若能進一步整合材料、設備製造及工程技術等關鍵能力，將有機會參與全球核能產業發展。期待透過此次合作，攜手產業夥伴建立更完整的供應鏈合作平台，共同掌握未來能源產業的新契機。
paras_en: Hua Xin (1605-TW) said today that as AI rapidly develops and drives up electricity demand, stable power supply and carbon reduction have become key issues in national energy policies, making nuclear power an option that balances low carbon emissions with supply resilience. To seize the global nuclear industry development opportunity, it announced a partnership with Century Energy (2072-TW), Gao Li (8996-TW) and Tai Feng to establish Hua Xin Century Nuclear Systems Co., Ltd., signing the agreement today to jointly develop the nuclear sector. Hua Xin added that it holds more than half of the shares and will consider capital increases depending on operational performance.

Hua Xin noted that Hua Xin Century Nuclear will integrate the professional technologies and industry resources of each partner, leverage complementary strengths, promote supply‑chain collaboration, and actively expand market opportunities both domestically and abroad.

Hua Xin said the company has internationally certified material capabilities and supply track records for nuclear projects, offering stainless steel, nickel‑based alloy materials, tubing and nuclear‑grade cables; Century Energy brings a professional welding team, extensive port area and dedicated heavy‑equipment transport terminals, facilitating large‑scale equipment manufacturing and export, and is simultaneously adopting ASME nuclear component manufacturing certification and authorized inspection services provided by Germany’s TÜV Rheinland.

Gao Li has long specialized in heat‑transfer and thermal‑flow technologies, as well as thermal‑management solutions for high‑temperature, high‑pressure environments, possessing core capabilities in metal processing, precision manufacturing and welding, and has accumulated experience developing and manufacturing energy‑generation systems and advanced heat exchangers; Tai Feng has long been rooted in energy‑related markets and is actively involved in the nuclear industry.

Hua Xin stated that emerging technologies such as small modular reactors (SMR) and micro‑modular reactors (MMR) are developing rapidly, and that integrating and localizing the nuclear supply chain has become a development trend.

In view of this, Hua Xin, together with reliable partners, will build a national‑level nuclear industry chain team, using its nuclear certification, material‑supply experience and track record to help joint‑venture parties establish a complete nuclear supply‑chain certification, further integrating the industry chain and supply capabilities. For example, it will combine its UK subsidiary’s aerospace and nuclear experience with Rolls‑Royce to develop manufacturing, assembly and component‑supply capabilities for SMR/MMR equipment, and cooperate with other leading European nuclear firms to supply European nuclear plants over the long term, expanding international nuclear industry opportunities.

Hua Xin said that after Hua Xin Century Nuclear is established, it will prioritize communication with government regulators, research institutes, industry associations and related entities to promote nuclear industry development and supply‑chain collaboration. In the early stage of operation, the focus will be on developing overseas nuclear markets, supporting domestic nuclear equipment and material needs, and promoting the existing products and technologies of its partners.

In the future, it will continue to combine resources from all sides, gradually develop integration capabilities for nuclear equipment and systems, and leverage domestic and overseas nuclear experience and R&D to build MMR and SMR construction and assembly capabilities for international markets, while preparing Taiwan for the manufacturing of next‑generation small nuclear reactors.

Chairman Jiao You‑lun of Hua Xin said Taiwan possesses a complete industrial base and manufacturing strength; if it can further integrate key capabilities such as materials, equipment manufacturing and engineering technology, it will have the opportunity to participate in global nuclear industry development. He looks forward to using this cooperation to jointly establish a more complete supply‑chain collaboration platform with industry partners and seize new opportunities in the future energy sector.

items.title: 綠能融資怎「解套」？中信銀李靜婷曝轉型3要件：從放款變身「投組」
items.title_en: How Can Green Energy Financing Be ‘Unlocked’? CTBC Bank’s Li Jing‑ting Reveals Three Key Elements for Transformation: From Lending to Investment Teams
paras: 中國信託商業銀行副總經理李靜婷今（3）日出席「綠能金融與資本市場創新論壇」於演講中強調，國內綠能產業正迎來關鍵轉型期，過去開發初期專注於銀行端的「可融資性」，當前最重要的任務是打通「從可融資到可投資」的轉化，但唯有透過資產評價標準化、提升資訊透明度與合約彈性三要件，並建立活躍的次級市場流動機制，就必須推動資產走向「可投資性」，吸引壽險資金、退休基金等廣大機構投資人接棒，全面釋放資本市場的永續資金動能。
李靜婷以「從可融資到可投資」為題發表專題演講，深入剖析本國商業銀行在綠能融資與投資市場轉化過程中的第一線觀察與實務解方。
李靜婷表示，在離岸風場與綠能專案開發初期，銀行端著重於評估工程可行性、合約架構嚴密性與還款來源，以確保專案具備「可融資性」。然而，當龐大風場陸續竣工運轉，若單靠商業銀行持續提供貸款，授信額度終將面臨上限。她強調，要讓綠能產業永續發展，就必須推動資產走向「可投資性」，吸引壽險資金、退休基金等廣大機構投資人接棒。
李靜婷進一步指出，要實現「從放款轉投資」，市場必須具備三大核心支撐：
資產評價標準化：建立市場公認且透明的風險與收益評價體系，降低廣大機構投資人的評估門檻與研究成本。
資訊透明度與合約彈性：持續公開營運與財務數據，並在融資合約中留出具彈性的再融資條款，以利後續架構調整。
次級市場流動機制：透過發行綠色資產證券化商品（如 REITs 模式或基礎建設基金），讓各類投資人能靈活進出，實現銀行資金的重複循環利用。
惠譽評級（Fitch Ratings）企業暨基礎建設專案融資特殊信用評等董事總經理 Sajal Kishore 發表「能源轉型資本化（Capitalising Energy Transition）」專題演講，從國際信用評等機構的視角，剖析全球綠能資產活化的趨勢與風險架構。

Sajal Kishore 在演講中指出，全球能源轉型正由初期的資本密集建置期，逐步轉向營運維護與資產資本化階段，而「能源轉型資本化」的核心機制在於「風險重配（Risk Allocation）」。在風險較高的興建期，應由開發商與專案融資銀行承擔；一旦進入營運穩定期、風險顯著降低後，即應透過再融資（Refinancing）讓建置期資本有序退出，改由追求長期穩定收益的機構資本（Institutional Capital）接手。
Sajal Kishore 亦提出評估綠能資產信用評等與資本化潛力的四大關鍵指標：
營運與維護（O&M）風險：資產長期運轉的穩定度及營運團隊的專業能力。
購售電合約（PPA）架構：具備長期且可預測的購售電條款，確保現金流穩定。
政策與法規穩定度：政府對再生能源監管政策與制度的延續性。
極端氣候風險：基礎設施因應氣候變遷與極端天候的抗風險韌性。
李靜婷與 Sajal Kishore 皆指出，台灣綠能產業要邁向下一階段的蓬勃發展，不能僅依賴傳統的銀行放款。透過銀行「可融資邁向可投資」次級市場創新，結合國際評級標準與再融資風險重配機制，將能有效釋放商業銀行的授信額度，引導民間長期資金源源不絕湧入，真正實現台灣綠色金融與能源轉型的雙贏格局。
paras_en: CTBC Bank Deputy General Manager Li Jing‑ting attended the “Green Energy Finance and Capital Market Innovation Forum” today (the 3rd) and stressed that Taiwan’s green energy industry is entering a critical transformation phase. In the early development stage, the focus was on the banks’ “financibility,” but now the most important task is to bridge the gap from “financible to investible.” This can only be achieved through three elements – standardised asset valuation, enhanced information transparency and contract flexibility, and the creation of an active secondary‑market liquidity mechanism – to make assets “investible,” attract institutional investors such as life‑insurance funds and pension funds, and fully unleash sustainable capital flows in the market.

Li Jing‑ting delivered a keynote titled “From Financible to Investible,” offering an in‑depth analysis of the frontline observations and practical solutions of domestic commercial banks in the conversion of green energy financing to investment markets.

She explained that in the offshore wind‑farm and green‑energy project development stage, banks concentrate on assessing engineering feasibility, contract robustness and repayment sources to ensure a project’s “financibility.” However, as large wind farms are completed and start operating, relying solely on commercial‑bank loans will eventually hit credit‑limit ceilings. She emphasized that for the green‑energy sector to sustain growth, assets must become “investible” to draw in institutional capital such as life‑insurance and pension funds.
Li further pointed out that to achieve a shift “from lending to investment,” the market must have three core supports:
Standardised asset valuation: Build a market‑recognised, transparent risk‑and‑return assessment framework to lower the evaluation barriers and research costs for institutional investors.

Information transparency and contract flexibility: Continuously disclose operational and financial data, and embed flexible refinancing clauses in financing contracts to facilitate later‑stage restructuring.

Secondary‑market liquidity mechanism: Issue green‑asset securitisation products (e.g., REIT‑style structures or infrastructure funds) so that various investors can enter and exit easily, enabling the repeated circulation of bank capital.

Sajal Kishore, Managing Director of Fitch Ratings’ corporate and infrastructure project financing special credit rating division, gave a presentation titled “Capitalising Energy Transition,” analysing global green‑asset activation trends and risk structures from an international credit‑rating perspective.

Kishore noted that the global energy transition is moving from an early, capital‑intensive build‑out phase to an operational‑maintenance and asset‑capitalisation stage, with the core mechanism of “energy‑transition capitalisation” being risk allocation. During the high‑risk construction phase, developers and project‑finance banks should bear the risk; once the asset reaches a stable operating phase with significantly reduced risk, refinancing should allow construction‑phase capital to exit orderly, handing over to institutional capital seeking long‑term stable returns.
Kishore also identified four key indicators for assessing the credit rating and capitalisation potential of green‑energy assets:
Operations & Maintenance (O&M) risk: The stability of long‑term asset operation and the professionalism of the O&M team.
Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) structure: Long‑term, predictable PPA terms that ensure stable cash flows.
Policy and regulatory stability: Continuity of government policies and regulatory frameworks for renewable energy.
Extreme climate risk: The resilience of infrastructure to climate change and extreme weather events.

Both Li Jing‑ting and Sajal Kishore concluded that Taiwan’s green‑energy industry cannot rely solely on traditional bank lending to reach its next growth stage. By innovating secondary‑market pathways that move banks from “financible” to “investible,” and by integrating international rating standards with refinancing risk‑allocation mechanisms, credit capacity of commercial banks can be effectively released, channeling continuous private long‑term capital into the sector and truly achieving a win‑win scenario for Taiwan’s green finance and energy transition.

items.title: 高雄食品展共吸引1.9萬人入場觀展 促成354場商務洽談
items.title_en: Kaohsiung Food Expo Attracts 19,000 Visitors, Facilitates 354 Business Meetings
paras: 由經濟部國貿署主辦、外貿協會執行的「2026年高雄國際食品展」，及貿協與展昭國際合辦的「2026年高雄國際飯店、餐飲暨烘焙設備用品展」，近期落幕，展期雖受颱風天候影響，仍不減買主與民眾熱情，累計吸引逾1.9萬人次入場，吸引15國41家國際買主來台採購，促成354場商務洽談，展現南臺灣食品產業的國際吸引力及高雄作為食品貿易與商務交流平台的豐沛能量。
貿協表示，此次使用逾520個攤位，展出台灣優質食品、水產加工、特色食材及餐飲設備等多元產品與解決方案，不僅展現食品產業創新實力，更促成國內外業者在產品代理、OEM代工及市場拓展等方面的合作契機。
其中首度參展的台廠中，萬味軒以泰式創新口味肉乾吸引泰國買主洽談代理；頤珍推出的漢方食養茶飲及燉包，亦獲得馬來西亞、泰、香港、美國等海外買主青睞，進一步洽談合作。
另展現馬紹爾群島、拉丁美洲及史瓦帝尼特色產品的「友邦國家館」亦受到關注，馬紹爾群島酒商MIPC及諾麗茶商KEJMOUR展出的產品，獲台灣進口商表達代理引進意願，為友邦特色商品開拓臺灣市場帶來新契機。
展期間舉辦的採購大會，邀集日本、美國、韓國、泰國、阿拉伯聯合大公國等15國、41家國際買主來台採購，吸引元家、老楊食品及上島食品等國內業者踴躍參與，透過面對面交流，協助台灣食品業者掌握海外市場需求、拓展國際通路，並為後續採購及合作奠定基礎。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ International Trade Administration organized the "2026 Kaohsiung International Food Expo" and, together with the Taiwan External Trade Development Council (TAITRA) and ExpoShow International, co‑hosted the "2026 Kaohsiung International Hotel, Restaurant and Bakery Equipment Expo." Although the exhibition period was affected by typhoon weather, buyer and public enthusiasm remained high, drawing more than 19,000 visitors, 15 countries and 41 international buyers to Taiwan for procurement and resulting in 354 business meetings, showcasing the international appeal of southern Taiwan’s food industry and Kaohsiung’s strong capacity as a food trade and business exchange platform.

TAITRA reported that over 520 booths displayed Taiwan’s high‑quality food, seafood processing, specialty ingredients and catering equipment, offering a wide range of products and solutions. The showcase not only highlighted the industry’s innovative strength but also created cooperation opportunities for domestic and foreign firms in product distribution, OEM manufacturing and market expansion.

Among the first‑time Taiwanese exhibitors, Wanweixuan attracted Thai buyers with its innovative Thai‑style flavored jerky for agency talks, while Yizhen’s herbal health tea drinks and steamed buns won interest from buyers in Malaysia, Thailand, Hong Kong and the United States, leading to further cooperation discussions.

The "Friend Nations Pavilion," featuring specialty products from the Marshall Islands, Latin America and Eswatini, also drew attention. Products exhibited by Marshall Islands liquor company MIPC and Noli tea trader KEJMOUR received expressions of interest from Taiwanese importers for agency and introduction, opening new opportunities for these nations’ unique goods in the Taiwan market.

During the expo, a procurement conference gathered buyers from 15 countries—including Japan, the United States, South Korea, Thailand and the United Arab Emirates—representing 41 international buyers who came to Taiwan to source products. Domestic companies such as Yuanjia, Lao Yang Foods and Shangdao Foods participated enthusiastically, using face‑to‑face interactions to help Taiwanese food firms understand overseas market needs, expand international channels, and lay the groundwork for future purchases and collaborations.

items.title: AI會引爆下一場金融海嘯嗎？前紐約聯準銀行總裁點出關鍵差別
items.title_en: Will AI Trigger the Next Financial Tsunami? Former New York Fed President Highlights Key Differences
paras: 若目前規劃的AI基礎設施全數建成，總投資可能超過10兆美元。前紐約聯準銀行總裁杜德利(Bill Dudley)在《彭博》專欄指出，考量資料中心折舊速度，AI產業每年可能需要至少3兆美元營收，才能為這筆投資帶來足夠報酬。
他認為，熱潮退去可能引發股市大幅修正，但要演變成另一場2008年規模的金融危機，機率仍低。更難判斷的是，一旦資料中心賺不到預期的錢，損失最後會落在誰身上。

七八家搶當AI巨頭 最後可能只剩兩三家贏家

杜德利指出，目前至少有七、八家企業競相成為大型AI運算服務供應商，但最終勝出的可能只有兩、三家。如同雲端服務市場，業者規模愈大，愈能分攤成本，既有客戶與服務也有助於吸引更多用戶。問題在於，每家公司都是按自己有望勝出的前提興建資料中心，加總起來，整個產業就可能蓋得太多。
這場競賽的資金來源包括企業現金流、股票與債券發行、私人信貸，以及大型雲端業者和輝達(NVDA-US)等供應商對資料中心開發商提供的擔保。部分建設採租賃方式融資，相關義務要等資料中心完工後才會出現在資產負債表上。光看企業目前帳面上的負債，投資人很難判斷，一旦計畫生變，還有哪些公司有義務出錢。
輝達對晶片未來價值提供的擔保，就是一個例子。若晶片價格大跌，輝達本身的利潤率可能已遭壓縮，卻也可能恰好在此時必須履行擔保。換句話說，開發商最需要這項保障的時候，也可能正是擔保方最難承擔損失的時候。

AI投資若退潮 為何重演金融海嘯的機率仍低

儘管如此，杜德利認為，這波AI融資與金融海嘯前的房貸市場仍有重要差別。當年，許多投資人深信美國房價不會在全國同步下跌，也把獲評AAA級的房貸相關證券視為安全資產。金融機構又以短期借款持有難以迅速變現的長期資產，一旦貸款違約增加、短期資金無法續借，就只能低價拋售，讓資產價格進一步下跌。
如今，市場已普遍討論AI投資過熱的風險，而且多數融資期限較長，更符合資料中心的投資年限。保險公司等長期投資人較有能力等候回收資金，私募基金也往往可以限制投資人贖回，降低業者被迫在市場低點出售資產的可能性。
杜德利主張，監管重點應放在資訊較不透明的非銀行金融機構。他建議明確賦予證券主管機關維護金融穩定的職責，由銀行與證券監管機關共同釐清誰向誰借錢、誰提供擔保，以及什麼情況下必須付款。
他也呼籲檢討會計規範，讓企業更完整揭露已承擔的債務與可能觸發的付款義務。如此一來，投資人才能判斷自己承擔多少風險，以及拿到的報酬是否足以補償。
paras_en: If all planned AI infrastructure is built, total investment could exceed $10 trillion. Former New York Federal Reserve Bank president Bill Dudley noted in a Bloomberg column that, given data‑center depreciation rates, the AI industry may need at least $3 trillion in annual revenue to generate sufficient returns on that investment.

He believes the hype’s fade could spark a sharp stock‑market correction, but the odds of it escalating into a crisis on the scale of 2008 remain low. What’s harder to gauge is who ultimately bears the loss if data centers fail to earn the expected profits.

Seven or eight firms are scrambling to become major AI compute service providers, yet only two or three are likely to emerge as winners. As in the cloud market, larger players can spread costs, retain existing customers and services, and attract more users. The problem is each company builds data centers on the premise that it will win, so the industry as a whole may end up over‑building.

Funding for this race comes from corporate cash flow, equity and bond issuances, private credit, and guarantees from large cloud operators and suppliers such as Nvidia (NVDA-US) to data‑center developers. Some construction is financed through leasing, with related obligations appearing on the balance sheet only after the facilities are completed. Looking solely at companies’ current book‑level debt makes it hard for investors to tell which firms would still be on the hook if plans change.

Nvidia’s guarantee of future chip value is an example. If chip prices plunge, Nvidia’s own profit margins could be squeezed, yet it might be forced to honor the guarantee at that moment. In other words, the developer’s need for protection may coincide with the guarantor’s hardest loss‑bearing situation.

Even so, Dudley sees important differences between today’s AI financing and the pre‑crisis mortgage market. Back then, many investors were convinced U.S. home prices wouldn’t fall nationwide and treated AAA‑rated mortgage‑backed securities as safe assets. Financial institutions held illiquid long‑term assets funded by short‑term borrowing; when defaults rose and short‑term funding dried up, they were forced to sell assets at low prices, pushing prices down further.

Today the market widely discusses the risk of an AI investment bubble, and most financing terms are longer, matching the investment horizon of data centers. Long‑term investors such as insurers are better able to wait for returns, and private‑equity funds can often restrict redemptions, reducing the chance that operators must sell assets at market lows.

Dudley argues that regulatory focus should target non‑bank financial institutions that are less transparent. He recommends explicitly giving securities regulators a mandate to safeguard financial stability, with banks and securities supervisors jointly clarifying who borrows from whom, who provides guarantees, and under what conditions payments must be made.

He also calls for a review of accounting standards to require companies to fully disclose incurred debt and potential payment obligations, so investors can assess their risk exposure and determine whether returns adequately compensate for that risk.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉民主黨若拿下國會 哪些美股最敏感？華爾街點名四大類股
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections: Which U.S. Stocks Are Most Sensitive If Democrats Take Congress? Wall Street Highlights Four Key Sectors
paras: 美國期中選舉投票登場，部分民調與多數預測市場看好民主黨拿下參眾兩院，但華爾街的持股布局尚未充分反映這種結果。據《CNBC》報導，摩根大通估計，若民主黨全面掌控國會，標普500指數周三(4日)可能下跌約0.5%；若共和黨失去眾院、卻守住參院，指數反而有望上漲最多1%。對投資人而言，選舉結果不只牽動大盤，也可能改變AI、國防、醫療與金融股的走勢。

選後美股未必照慣例上漲 今年起點不同

選前民調顯示，民主黨有望奪下眾院，參院則勝負難料；預測市場更偏向民主黨包辦兩院。Wolfe Research美國政策與政治研究主管Tobin Marcus表示，該機構訪查逾百名機構投資人後發現，投資人雖已逐漸接受民主黨可能勝選，卻未明顯押注任何一種結果，部分原因是他們懷疑民調高估了民主黨的實力。
富國銀行投資研究所認為，若共和黨守住兩院，政策走向較容易預判，美股短線可望反彈。花旗則看好另一種結果：即使民主黨贏得眾院，只要共和黨保住參院，兩黨分掌國會也可能有利於美股年底行情。
歷史經驗對多頭有利。自1980年代初以來，每次期中選舉結束一年後，標普500指數都高於選舉時的水準。不過，BTIG首席技術分析師Jonathan Krinsky指出，歷來期中選舉年，標普500指數在下半年一度自高點回落的幅度平均達14%，選前走弱，才替11月反彈創造空間。今年標普500指數在投票前已累積兩位數漲幅，他因此認為，這次選後下跌的可能性反而較高。

AI股留意德州州長選情 醫療股看補助政策

近來AI股賣壓沉重，若民主黨在更多州取得執政權，投資人可能更擔心資料中心建設面臨限制。除了國會席次，Marcus也點名德州州長選舉。德州是美國資料中心建設重鎮，共和黨籍州長艾 Abbott若意外落敗，可能在短期內衝擊相關股票。高盛則認為，民主黨若掌控國會，可能縮減資料中心的租稅優惠，但無論選舉結果如何，全美暫停興建資料中心的機率都很低。
國防股與醫療股面對的政策前景也不同。富國銀行投資研究所分析師Alex Sagal指出，若民主黨大勝，扣除通膨後的國防支出成長空間可能受限，除非兩黨就同步增加國防與醫療經費達成協議。不過，他對國防業獲利的展望仍是持穩至溫和成長。

醫療股則可能受惠。Marcus預期，民主黨將爭取恢復《平價醫療法》已到期的加碼保費補助，並推動撤回部分針對聯邦醫療補助計畫(Medicaid)的改革。Argent Capital Management投資組合經理Jed Ellerbroek認為，近期醫療股走強，除了資金從AI股轉進，也有投資人在押注民主黨勝選。他關注的個股包括醫院營運商HCA Healthcare(HCA-US)、Tenet Healthcare(THC-US)，以及健康保險商聯合健康(UNH-US)與Centene(CNC-US)。

銀行留意信用卡利率上限 伊朗局勢牽動年底行情

金融股面對的變數，是川普年初曾要求國會將信用卡利率上限訂在10%。當時金融股一度成為標普500表現最差的類股，之後雖有回升，今年來漲幅約3%。Evercore ISI分析師Matthew Aks認為，若民主黨掌控至少一院，為了回應選民對生活成本的關切，可能再次推動信用卡利率上限，爭取川普支持。這也讓銀行業成為少數可能同時面臨兩黨政策壓力的產業。
選舉之外，美國是否在投票結束後擴大對伊朗的軍事行動，也是年底行情的一大變數。原油價格10月上漲逾10%，周一回吐不少漲幅。根據美國汽車協會(AAA)資料，截至周日，全美汽油均價仍達每加侖4.17美元，較去年同期高出近四成。若衝突升級，油價可能在感恩節出遊旺季前再度走高，能源股也可能因此優於大盤。
Evercore ISI提出的悲觀情境有兩項前提：民主黨拿下國會，而且川普在明年1月新一屆國會就任前擴大對伊朗的軍事行動。若兩者同時發生並推升油價，該機構估計，標普500指數到年底可能出現兩位數跌幅，下探6,800點。
paras_en: U.S. midterm elections are underway, and while many polls and most forecasts expect the Democratic Party to win both the House and the Senate, Wall Street’s portfolio allocations have not yet fully reflected that outcome. According to CNBC, JPMorgan estimates that if Democrats gain full control of Congress, the S&P 500 could fall about 0.5% on Wednesday (the 4th); if Republicans lose the House but hold the Senate, the index could instead rise up to 1%. For investors, the election result not only moves the broad market but could also shift the trajectories of AI, defense, healthcare and financial stocks.

Post‑election, U.S. equities may not follow the usual rally because this year’s starting point is different. Pre‑election polls show Democrats likely to capture the House, while the Senate remains uncertain; the market leans toward a Democratic sweep of both chambers. Wolfe Research’s head of U.S. policy and politics, Tobin Marcus, said that after surveying over a hundred institutional investors, they are gradually accepting a possible Democratic win but are not heavily betting on any outcome, partly because they doubt polls overstate Democratic strength.

Wells Fargo’s investment research believes that if Republicans retain both chambers, policy direction will be easier to predict and U.S. stocks could rebound in the short term. Citi, on the other hand, is bullish on a different scenario: even if Democrats win the House, as long as Republicans keep the Senate, a split Congress could still be favorable for the market’s year‑end performance.

Historical experience favors the bulls. Since the early 1980s, the S&P 500 has been higher a year after every midterm election than at election time. However, BTIG chief technical analyst Jonathan Krinsky notes that in past midterm years the index has fallen an average of 14% from its peak in the second half, weakening before the election and creating room for a November rebound. This year the S&P 500 had already logged double‑digit gains before voting, leading him to think a post‑election decline is more likely this time.

AI stocks have been under heavy selling pressure, and if Democrats take control of more states investors may worry about restrictions on data‑center construction. Marcus also singled out the Texas governor’s race. Texas is a hub for U.S. data centers, and a surprise loss by Republican Governor Greg Abbott could temporarily hit related stocks. Goldman Sachs thinks a Democratic‑controlled Congress might trim tax incentives for data centers, but regardless of the outcome the likelihood of a nationwide halt to data‑center builds remains low.

Defense and healthcare stocks face different policy outlooks. Wells Fargo analyst Alex Sagal says that a Democratic landslide could limit real‑after‑inflation growth in defense spending unless both parties agree to boost defense and healthcare budgets together. Nonetheless, he still expects defense earnings to grow modestly to steadily.

Healthcare stocks could benefit. Marcus expects Democrats to push to restore the expired premium subsidies under the Affordable Care Act and roll back parts of recent Medicaid reforms. Argent Capital Management portfolio manager Jed Ellerbroek notes that recent strength in healthcare stocks stems not only from funds rotating out of AI but also from investors betting on a Democratic win. He watches hospital operators HCA Healthcare (HCA‑US), Tenet Healthcare (THC‑US), and insurers UnitedHealth (UNH‑US) and Centene (CNC‑US).

Bank stocks are watching the credit‑card interest‑rate cap and the Iran situation as year‑end drivers. A variable for financials is that former President Trump earlier this year asked Congress to set a 10% ceiling on credit‑card rates. Financials briefly became the worst‑performing S&P 500 sector, later recovering and gaining about 3% this year. Evercore ISI analyst Matthew Aks says that if Democrats control at least one chamber, they may revive the cap to address voter concerns about living costs, courting Trump’s support. This makes banks one of the few sectors facing pressure from both parties.

Beyond the election, whether the U.S. expands military action against Iran after the vote is another year‑end market variable. Crude prices rose more than 10% in October before retreating on Monday. According to the American Automobile Association (AAA), as of Sunday the national average gasoline price was $4.17 per gallon, nearly 40% higher than a year ago. If the conflict escalates, oil could climb again before the Thanksgiving travel season, giving energy stocks an edge over the broader market.

Evercore ISI’s pessimistic scenario rests on two premises: Democrats win Congress and Trump expands military action against Iran before the new Congress convenes in January. If both occur and push oil higher, the firm estimates the S&P 500 could suffer a double‑digit decline by year‑end, slipping to around 6,800 points.

items.title: 9月飛機訂單大增近三成！美國工廠接單連三月成長
items.title_en: September Aircraft Orders Surge Nearly 30% as U.S. Factory Orders Grow for Third Consecutive Month
paras: 美國9月工廠訂單月增1.8%，優於市場預估的1.2%，連續第三個月成長。波動較大的民航機及零件訂單大增28.3%，是推升整體數據的主要動力。不過，即使扣除運輸設備，工廠訂單仍月增1.3%，機械、電腦與電子產品接單均有成長，顯示需求也延伸至航空業以外的製造部門。
美國商務部人口普查局周二(3日)公布，9月經季節調整後的工廠新訂單增加122億美元，達6,772億美元，8月增幅則由0.1%上修至0.3%。以未經季節調整的數據計算，9月訂單金額較去年同月增加約10.8%，今年前九個月累計較去年同期成長7.2%。
其中，耐久財訂單月增1.9%，高於初估的1.8%，以運輸設備訂單增加4.6%貢獻最大。相較於飛機訂單大增，汽車車身、零件及拖車訂單僅增加0.1%。其他產業方面，機械訂單月增1.5%，電腦與電子產品增加0.8%，電氣設備、家電及零組件則減少0.3%。非耐久財訂單也較前月增加1.8%。
企業設備投資也有回溫跡象。用來觀察企業設備支出計畫的核心資本財訂單，也就是扣除飛機的非國防資本財訂單，9月增幅由初估的0.5%上修至0.6%；這類設備的出貨額則月增1.2%，與初估一致。
據《路透》報導，AI基礎設施投資與強韌的消費支出，持續支撐美國製造業，該產業約占美國經濟的9.4%。不過，接單增加之際，業者對前景仍有顧慮。美國供應管理協會(ISM)周一公布的調查顯示，10月工廠生產強勁，但製造商信心持續惡化，業者點名價格波動、交期拉長、關稅，以及美國與以色列對伊朗的戰事，都是經營壓力來源。
經濟學家提醒，隨著利率走高，家庭所得扣除通膨後也在下滑，明年製造業活動可能放緩，尤其是較少受惠於AI投資的產業。
paras_en: U.S. factory orders rose 1.8% month‑over‑month in September, beating the market’s 1.2% forecast and marking a third straight month of growth. Orders for civil aircraft and parts, which are highly volatile, jumped 28.3%, driving the overall increase. Even after stripping out transportation equipment, factory orders were still up 1.3% month‑over‑month, with machinery, computer and electronic product orders all rising, indicating demand extending beyond the aviation sector into other manufacturing segments.

The U.S. Census Bureau of the Commerce Department announced on Tuesday (the 3rd) that seasonally adjusted new factory orders in September increased by $12.2 billion to $677.2 billion, with August’s growth revised from 0.1% to 0.3%. On a non‑seasonally adjusted basis, September’s order value was about 10.8% higher than the same month last year, and the cumulative total for the first nine months of this year was 7.2% above the comparable period a year earlier.

Durable‑goods orders rose 1.9% month‑over‑month, above the initial estimate of 1.8%, led by a 4.6% increase in transportation equipment orders. While aircraft orders surged, orders for automobile bodies, parts and trailers edged up only 0.1%. In other sectors, machinery orders grew 1.5%, computers and electronic products rose 0.8%, and electrical equipment, household appliances and components fell 0.3%. Non‑durable‑goods orders also rose 1.8% from the prior month.

Business equipment investment is showing signs of a rebound. Core capital‑goods orders – the metric used to gauge corporate equipment‑spending plans and which excludes aircraft and defense capital goods – were revised up to a 0.6% increase in September from the initial 0.5% estimate; shipments of this equipment class rose 1.2% month‑over‑month, in line with the original forecast.

According to Reuters, AI‑related infrastructure spending and resilient consumer demand continue to underpin U.S. manufacturing, which accounts for roughly 9.4% of the U.S. economy. However, despite the order uptick, firms remain cautious about the outlook. A survey released by the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) on Monday showed strong factory production in October, but manufacturer confidence kept deteriorating, with respondents citing price volatility, longer lead times, tariffs and the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran as sources of pressure.

Economists warn that as interest rates stay high, real household incomes are slipping after inflation, which could dampen manufacturing activity next year, especially in sectors that are less likely to benefit from AI investment.

items.title: 美天然氣業者Williams跨足發電 年底前再公布電力專案
items.title_en: US Natural Gas Company Williams Expands into Power Generation, Plans Additional Power Projects by Year‑End
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國天然氣基礎設施業者Williams(WMB-US)正從天然氣輸送延伸至發電業務。公司在法說會表示，預計年底前再公布1至2項電力專案，並預期未來合約年期將拉長，持續擴大資料中心供電布局。
Williams原本以天然氣輸送、儲存與處理為核心業務，隨著資料中心用電需求增加，公司也開始參與發電專案，將業務從供應燃料延伸至供應電力。公司表示，選舉預料不會延誤資料中心專案，相關供電計畫持續推進。
發電業務已開始貢獻業績。Williams在最新財報中指出，新增發電收入、陸續投運的專案及較高的天然氣儲存收入，帶動輸送、電力與墨西哥灣事業成長，但部分增幅被營運及管理費用增加抵銷。
既有專案方面，Socrates旗下Plato North電力專案仍按進度推進，預計11月中旬投入營運。天然氣輸送業務也持續擴建，Line 200專案則以2028年底投入服務為目標。

paras_en: November 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – U.S. natural‑gas infrastructure firm Williams (WMB‑US) is extending its business from gas transportation into power generation. In its earnings call the company said it expects to announce one or two more power projects before the end of the year and anticipates longer‑term contracts that will further expand its power‑supply footprint for data centers.

Williams has traditionally focused on natural‑gas transmission, storage and processing. As data‑center electricity demand rises, the company has begun to take part in power‑generation projects, moving from supplying fuel to supplying electricity. Williams said the election is not expected to delay data‑center projects and related power‑supply plans remain on track.

The power‑generation business is already contributing to results. In its latest financial report Williams highlighted new power‑generation revenue, the commissioning of projects and higher natural‑gas storage income, which together boosted its transmission, power and Gulf of Mexico segments, although part of the gain was offset by higher operating and administrative expenses.

Regarding existing projects, the Plato North power project under the Socrates umbrella continues on schedule and is slated to begin operations in mid‑November. The natural‑gas transmission expansion also proceeds, with the Line 200 project targeted to enter service by the end of 2028.

items.title: 速食餐飲｜Taco Bell第三季同店銷售減4% 百勝指本季已回升
items.title_en: Fast Food | Taco Bell’s Same‑Store Sales Down 4% in Q3, Yum! Says the Quarter Has Rebounded
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 百勝餐飲(YUM-US)表示，旗下墨西哥風味速食品牌Taco Bell的銷售正逐步復甦，第四季迄今同店銷售成長約1%。該品牌第三季受美國多州爆發的環孢子蟲感染疫情拖累，同店銷售下滑4%，為約六年來首度衰退，降幅也大於市場預估的0.9%。
Taco Bell於7月初被指與疫情有關，依Placer.ai統計，疫情高峰期間單週來客數曾減少20%；美國衛生當局已於10月宣布疫情結束。百勝指出，優惠套餐有助吸引承受通膨壓力的低收入家庭，會員促銷及合作活動也正帶動顧客回流。
銷售回溫尚未反映在第三季整體業績。百勝當季同店銷售與去年持平，低於市場預期的成長0.9%；KFC同店銷售增加1%，也不及預估的2.1%。不過，調整後每股盈餘雖年減1.3%至1.56美元，仍高於分析師預估的1.49美元。
