paras_en: November 4, 2026 (Yoo Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Yum! Brands (YUM‑US) said its Mexican‑style fast‑food chain Taco Bell is gradually recovering, with same‑store sales up about 1% so far in the fourth quarter. The brand’s third‑quarter same‑store sales fell 4% after a cyclospora outbreak in several U.S. states, marking the first decline in roughly six years and a drop larger than the market’s 0.9% forecast.

Taco Bell was linked to the outbreak in early July; according to Placer.ai, weekly foot traffic fell as much as 20% at the peak of the incident. U.S. health authorities announced in October that the outbreak was over. Yum! noted that value meals are helping attract low‑income families feeling inflation pressure, and member promotions and partnership events are also driving customers back.

The sales rebound has not yet shown in the overall third‑quarter results. Yum!’s same‑store sales for the quarter were flat year‑over‑year, missing the market‑expected 0.9% growth; KFC’s same‑store sales rose 1%, also below the projected 2.1%. Nevertheless, adjusted earnings per share fell 1.3% year‑over‑year to $1.56, still above analysts’ estimate of $1.49.

items.title: 美股藏著「隱形熊市」？標普500距高點僅3% 六成成分股卻跌了至少兩成
items.title_en: Is a "Hidden Bear Market" Lurking in US Stocks? S&P 500 Only 3% From Its Peak, Yet 60% of Its Components Have Fallen At Least 20%
paras: 標普500指數距離歷史高點僅約3%，但高盛集團(GS-US)交易員Bobby Molavi指出，指數內已有六成成分股自各自高點下跌至少20%，進入熊市區間。他形容，美股正經歷一場「隱形熊市」。尤其令他意外的是，砸重金興建AI基礎設施的科技巨頭，與承接這些訂單的供應商，股價竟然一起下跌。
據《彭博》報導，主管高盛歐洲、中東與非洲交易執行業務的Molavi在客戶報告中指出，市場普遍仍相信AI將改變各行各業，卻同時下修買方與供應商的估值。自10月15日以來，美股「七巨頭」合計市值已蒸發4兆美元。在他的印象中，這是這些公司首度交出財報後，投資人仍普遍覺得成績不夠好。
不過，過去一個月，多數標普500成分股其實仍有上漲。這與六成個股身處熊市並不矛盾：前者看的是近一個月的漲跌，後者衡量的是股價距各自高點有多遠。隨著資金撤出原本集中的AI股，轉向防禦型類股及先前較少人持有的股票，部分個股雖然反彈，距高點仍遠。
這波資金輪動在上周四尤其明顯。當天，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)股價創20年來最大跌幅，單日市值蒸發5,000億美元，但醫療保健、房地產及民生必需品類股撐盤，標普500指數僅跌0.3%。晶片股承受的賣壓則重得多，費城半導體指數上周五收跌7%，一年來首度跌破200日均線，預估本益比降至約16倍，回到這波AI行情的低點附近。
Molavi認為，從最新財報來看，雲端需求依然強勁。Google Cloud營收翻倍，微軟(MSFT-US)旗下Azure成長48%，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下AWS營收也成長39%，創五年來最快增速。投資人真正想知道的是，科技巨頭還得花多少錢，以及這些投資要多久才能帶來回報。
據Molavi統計，四大科技業者合計創造的自由現金流只剩260億美元，遠低於以往水準。為了支應AI建設，企業除了動用手中現金，也愈來愈依賴發債與股權籌資。以亞馬遜為例，短短九個月，長期債務就從660億美元增至1,730億美元。Molavi認為，上周財報季顯示，市場對AI投資的評價標準已經改變：投資人更在意企業花出去的錢何時能賺回來。
在他眼中，債市傳出的警訊更值得留意。據其統計，自1996年以來，B級與信用評等更低的CCC級債券之間，殖利率差距達到8個百分點的情況不到五次。過去每次出現這個訊號，標普500指數當時都已較52周高點低至少11.5%，其中兩次更接近低了三成。這一次，在同樣的利差訊號出現時，標普500指數進入上周前距高點卻不到2%。
paras_en: The S&P 500 index is just about 3% shy of its historical high, but Goldman Sachs trader Bobby Molavi said that roughly 60% of its constituents have each dropped at least 20% from their own peaks, putting them in bear‑market territory. He described the US equity market as undergoing a "hidden bear market," noting that even the tech giants pouring massive capital into AI infrastructure and the suppliers fulfilling those orders have seen their shares fall together.

According to Bloomberg, Molavi, who heads Goldman’s Europe, Middle East and Africa trading execution business, wrote in a client report that the market still broadly believes AI will transform every industry, yet valuations for both buyers and suppliers have been trimmed. Since October 15, the combined market cap of the US “big‑seven” tech firms has evaporated $4 trillion. In his view, this is the first time after these companies reported earnings that investors generally felt the results were still underwhelming.

However, over the past month most S&P 500 components have actually risen. This does not contradict the fact that 60% of stocks are in a bear market: the former looks at one‑month price moves, while the latter measures how far a stock is from its own peak. As money has fled the once‑concentrated AI stocks and shifted toward defensive sectors and previously less‑held shares, some stocks have rebounded but remain far from their highs.

The rotation was especially evident last Thursday. On that day Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US), Google’s parent, posted its biggest one‑day drop in 20 years, wiping out $500 billion in market value, while healthcare, real estate and consumer‑staples stocks provided support and the S&P 500 fell only 0.3%. Semiconductor stocks faced far heavier selling; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 7% on Friday, breaking below its 200‑day moving average for the first time in a year and seeing its forward P/E fall to roughly 16×, back near the low point of the AI rally.

Molavi believes that, based on the latest earnings, cloud demand remains robust. Google Cloud revenue doubled, Microsoft’s Azure grew 48%, and Amazon’s AWS revenue rose 39%, the fastest five‑year pace. Investors really want to know how much more the tech giants will have to spend and how long it will take for those investments to pay off.

Molavi’s calculations show that the four major tech firms together generated only $26 billion of free cash flow, far below historic levels. To fund AI build‑outs, companies are not only tapping cash on hand but increasingly turning to debt and equity issuance. For Amazon, long‑term debt jumped from $66 billion to $173 billion in just nine months. Molavi says the latest earnings season indicates that the market’s criteria for valuing AI investment have shifted: investors care more about when the money spent will be earned back.

In his view, warning signs from the bond market deserve even more attention. Since 1996, the spread between B‑rated and lower‑rated CCC bonds has widened to 8 percentage points fewer than five times. Each time that signal appeared in the past, the S&P 500 was already at least 11.5% below its 52‑week high, with two instances seeing a drop of about 30%. This time, when the same spread signal emerged, the S&P 500 was less than 2% away from its recent peak.

items.title: Fed能鬆口氣了？美國9月職缺意外增至752.3萬個 創四個月新高
items.title_en: Can the Fed Breathe Easier? U.S. September Job Openings Unexpectedly Rise to 7.523 Million, a Four‑Month High
paras: 美國9月職缺意外增加33.3萬個，達752.3萬個，創四個月新高。企業實際聘僱人數也回升，裁員降至一年半來最低，主動離職人數則較上月增加逾一成。這些變化顯示，美國就業市場進入第四季前仍有韌性，讓聯準會(Fed)有空間繼續關注通膨。不過，9月非農就業人數僅增加2.9萬人，企業是否已開始加快擴編，仍待更多數據確認。

職缺超出市場預期 州與地方政府增幅突出

綜合外媒報導，美國勞工統計局周二(3日)公布職缺與勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)，9月底職缺高於《路透》調查預估的710萬個，也超過《彭博》調查中所有經濟學家的預測。8月職缺由707.9萬個上修至719萬個，9月職缺率則從4.3%升至4.5%。
從產業來看，光是州與地方政府，不含教育部門，就增加10.4萬個職缺。專業與商業服務、資訊、貿易與運輸、營建及製造業的職缺也增加。房地產、租賃與租借業職缺從前月的5.2萬個回升至7.5萬個，金融、民間教育與醫療服務等產業的職缺則減少。
Fed關注的勞動供需指標也略有回升。9月職缺比失業人數多出41.4萬個，高於8月的15.9萬個，相當於每名失業者平均對應約1.1個職缺，高於8月的約1個。相比之下，2022年企業搶人高峰時，每名失業者約有2個職缺可選，目前整體供需仍大致平衡。

主動離職人數月增逾一成 周五非農將見分曉

9月主動離職人數從304.4萬人增至336.5萬人，單月增加32.1萬人，增幅約10.5%。主動離職率升至2.1%，創逾一年新高。更多勞工願意離開原有職位，可能反映他們對找到下一份工作更有信心。其中，住宿與餐飲服務業人員流動尤其明顯，既是當月聘僱成長的主力，也有大批員工主動離職。
整體而言，9月企業實際聘僱人數增加13.1萬人，達540.2萬人，聘僱率從3.3%升至3.4%。同月裁員及解僱人數減少12.7萬人，降至164.1萬人，為2025年3月以來最低。經濟學家指出，內需穩健、企業獲利良好，有助於減少裁員，但物價高漲與中東戰事仍讓部分雇主對增聘人手保持謹慎。
這也解釋了為何9月職缺大增，非農就業人數卻僅增加2.9萬人：職缺反映月底尚待填補的職位，非農數據衡量的則是整體就業人數的淨變動。加上JOLTS調查回覆率已較疫情前下降，職缺與聘僱若能連續數月回升，才更能判斷企業是否正走出「少聘僱、少裁員」的狀態。
Fed在9月進行三年來首次升息後，上周維持利率不變，並表示就業成長與勞動力增幅大致相當，失業率變動不大。市場接下來將關注周五公布的10月非農就業報告。《路透》調查顯示，經濟學家預估新增就業人數將回升至6.5萬人，失業率則料持平於4.2%。
paras_en: U.S. job openings unexpectedly increased by 333,000 in September, reaching 7.523 million, a four‑month high. Actual hiring by firms also rebounded, layoffs fell to the lowest level in a year and a half, and quits rose by more than 10% from the prior month. These changes show that the U.S. labor market remains resilient heading into the fourth quarter, giving the Federal Reserve room to keep focusing on inflation. However, non‑farm payrolls grew by only 29,000 in September, so whether firms are truly accelerating hiring still requires more data.

Job openings exceeded market expectations, with state and local government leading the gains. According to a composite of foreign media reports, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released its Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on Tuesday (the 3rd). By the end of September, job openings were higher than Reuters’ forecast of 7.1 million and above the range predicted by Bloomberg’s poll of economists. August openings were revised up from 7.079 million to 7.19 million, and the September job‑opening rate rose from 4.3% to 4.5%.

By industry, state and local governments alone added 104,000 openings, not counting the education sector. Professional and business services, information, trade and transportation, construction and manufacturing also saw increases. Real estate, leasing and rental openings rose from 52,000 in the prior month to 75,000, while openings in finance, private education and health services fell.

The labor‑supply‑demand indicator that the Fed watches also ticked up slightly. In September, job openings exceeded the number of unemployed by 414,000, up from a surplus of 159,000 in August, meaning there were about 1.1 openings per unemployed worker, versus roughly one per worker in August. By contrast, at the peak of the 2022 hiring frenzy, each unemployed worker had about two openings to choose from, so overall supply‑demand remains roughly balanced.

Quitters rose by more than 10% month‑over‑month. In September, quits increased from 3.044 million to 3.365 million, a monthly rise of 321,000 or about 10.5%. The quit rate climbed to 2.1%, a new high in over a year. More workers are willing to leave their current jobs, likely reflecting greater confidence in finding new employment. Turnover was especially pronounced in the accommodation and food‑service sector, which also drove most of the month’s hiring growth while seeing a large number of workers voluntarily exit.

Overall, firms’ actual hiring in September rose by 131,000 to 5.402 million, lifting the hiring rate from 3.3% to 3.4%. Layoffs and discharges fell by 127,000 to 1.641 million, the lowest level since March 2025. Economists note that solid domestic demand and strong corporate profits help curb layoffs, though high inflation and Middle‑East conflicts keep some employers cautious about adding staff.

This helps explain why job openings surged while non‑farm payrolls grew by only 29,000: openings reflect positions that remain unfilled at month‑end, whereas the non‑farm figure measures the net change in total employment. Moreover, the JOLTS response rate has already fallen below pre‑pandemic levels. Only if openings and hiring continue to rise for several months can we tell whether firms are moving out of a “low‑hiring, low‑layoff” phase.

After the Fed’s first rate hike in three years in September, it kept rates steady last week and said employment growth and labor‑force gains were broadly in line, with little change in the unemployment rate. Markets will now focus on Friday’s release of the October non‑farm payroll report. Reuters’ poll shows economists expect job gains to rebound to 65,000 and the unemployment rate to hold steady at 4.2%.

items.title: Meta為AI建設發債！美元債擬籌150億美元 首批歐元債最快周三登場
items.title_en: Meta builds bonds for AI! USD bond to raise $15 billion, first Euro bond as early as Wednesday
paras: 據《彭博》報導，臉書母公司Meta(META-US)已啟動跨幣別發債計畫，目標透過美元債籌集約150億美元，並預計最快周三(4日)首次發行歐元債。知情人士透露，Meta計劃合計籌資至少200億美元，最終規模仍可能視認購需求調高。
這是Meta相隔半年再度進入投資級債券市場。此次美元債分五批發行，期限從5年到30年不等，其中30年期債券的初步報價，較同天期美債殖利率高約2.5個百分點。Meta與負責承銷的花旗集團(C-US)、摩根士丹利(MS-US)均不予置評。
今年4月，Meta曾發債籌得250億美元，認購金額高峰達960億美元，接近發行規模的4倍。如今，大型科技公司相繼為AI基礎設施籌資，債券買家也開始要求更高的風險溢價，才願意承接新債。
光是本周一，甲骨文(ORCL-US)就發行了100億美元債券，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)也透過歐元債籌得60億歐元。微軟(MSFT-US)則在上周發債250億美元。《彭博》行業研究估計，其追蹤的大型雲端業者與專營AI運算的新興雲端公司，未來三年投資總額將逼近4.5兆美元。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, Facebook parent Meta (META-US) has launched a multi‑currency bond issuance program, aiming to raise about $15 billion through U.S. dollar bonds and planning to issue the first Euro bonds as early as Wednesday (the 4th). Sources said Meta intends to raise at least $20 billion in total, and the final size could be increased depending on demand.

This marks Meta’s return to the investment‑grade bond market after a six‑month hiatus. The U.S. dollar bonds will be issued in five tranches with maturities ranging from 5 to 30 years, and the preliminary price for the 30‑year bond is about 2.5 percentage points higher than the comparable U.S. Treasury yield. Meta and the lead underwriters, Citigroup (C-US) and Morgan Stanley (MS-US), declined to comment.

In April this year, Meta issued bonds that raised $25 billion, with order books peaking at $96 billion, nearly four times the issuance size. Today, large tech firms are successively raising capital for AI infrastructure, and bond investors are demanding higher risk premiums before agreeing to take on new issues.

Just on Monday, Oracle (ORCL-US) issued $10 billion of bonds, and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) (GOOG-US) raised €6 billion through Euro bonds. Microsoft (MSFT-US) issued $25 billion of bonds last week. Bloomberg’s industry research estimates that the total investment by the large cloud providers it tracks and emerging cloud companies focused on AI computing will approach $4.5 trillion over the next three years.

items.title: 晶片子公司告母公司！安世告上荷蘭法院 聞泰稱遭索賠20億美元
items.title_en: Chip Subsidiary Sues Parent! Nexperia Takes Case to Dutch Court, Wentech Claims $2 B Claim
paras: 荷蘭晶片商安世半導體周二(3日)宣布，已在荷蘭法院對中國母公司聞泰科技(600745-CN)及其創辦人張學政提起訴訟，要求賠償營運損失。安世並未在聲明中公布求償金額；聞泰則表示，安世要求被告合計賠償20億美元，聞泰對所有指控及求償要求均予以否認。
據《路透》報導，聞泰轉述安世荷蘭方面的主張指出，安世中國及安世上海違反與荷蘭公司簽訂的內部協議，應賠償相關損失。據聞泰說法，安世還指控被告在中國另建獨立供應鏈，干擾其營運，並與安世形成直接競爭，構成荷蘭法律所指的不公平商業行為。
安世在聲明中表示，被告的行為已對公司及業務造成重大損害，因此提告求償。聞泰則表示，目前尚未收到正式訴訟文書，法院也尚未受理此案；若法院受理並正式送達，將聘請海外律師應訴。
這場爭端可追溯至2025年9月。當時荷蘭政府介入安世半導體，表示目的是防止公司將業務移往中國。北京隨後一度禁止安世晶片出口。由於安世的晶片在中國東莞封裝，出口受阻一度導致汽車製造商面臨晶片短缺。
安世生產的基礎晶片廣泛用於汽車與消費電子產品。荷中兩國政府後來陸續撤回相關措施，車用晶片供應壓力隨之緩解，但安世在荷蘭與中國的業務至今仍處於分裂狀態。聞泰雖仍是安世的母公司，卻已因荷蘭法院裁定而失去對安世的控制權。
paras_en: Dutch chipmaker Nexperia Semiconductor announced on Tuesday (the 3rd) that it has filed a lawsuit in a Dutch court against its Chinese parent Wentech Technology (600745-CN) and its founder Zhang Xuezheng, seeking compensation for operational losses. Nexperia did not disclose the amount sought in its statement; Wentech says Nexperia is demanding a total of $2 billion in damages, which Wentech denies all allegations and claims.

According to Reuters, Wentech relayed Nexperia’s Dutch side’s claim that Nexperia China and Nexperia Shanghai violated internal agreements signed with the Dutch company and must compensate related losses. Wentech says Nexperia also accused the defendants of building an independent supply chain in China, disrupting its operations and directly competing with Nexperia, which constitutes unfair commercial conduct under Dutch law.

In its statement, Nexperia said the defendants’ actions have caused significant damage to the company and its business, prompting the lawsuit for compensation. Wentech said it has not yet received formal court documents and the case has not been taken up by the court; if the court does accept it and serve the papers, it will hire overseas counsel to respond.

The dispute dates back to September 2025, when the Dutch government intervened in Nexperia to prevent the company from moving its business to China. Beijing subsequently banned Nexperia chip exports for a time. Because Nexperia’s chips were packaged in Dongguan, China, the export blockage briefly caused a chip shortage for automobile manufacturers.

Nexperia’s base chips are widely used in automotive and consumer electronics. The Dutch and Chinese governments later rolled back the measures, easing pressure on automotive chip supply, but Nexperia’s operations in the Netherlands and China remain split. Although Wentech remains Nexperia’s parent, it has lost control of Nexperia following the Dutch court ruling.

items.title: AI會引爆下一場金融海嘯嗎？前紐約聯準銀行總裁點出關鍵差別
items.title_en: Will AI Trigger the Next Financial Tsunami? Former New York Fed President Highlights Key Differences
paras: 若目前規劃的AI基礎設施全數建成，總投資可能超過10兆美元。前紐約聯準銀行總裁杜德利(Bill Dudley)在《彭博》專欄指出，考量資料中心折舊速度，AI產業每年可能需要至少3兆美元營收，才能為這筆投資帶來足夠報酬。
他認為，熱潮退去可能引發股市大幅修正，但要演變成另一場2008年規模的金融危機，機率仍低。更難判斷的是，一旦資料中心賺不到預期的錢，損失最後會落在誰身上。

七八家搶當AI巨頭 最後可能只剩兩三家贏家

杜德利指出，目前至少有七、八家企業競相成為大型AI運算服務供應商，但最終勝出的可能只有兩、三家。如同雲端服務市場，業者規模愈大，愈能分攤成本，既有客戶與服務也有助於吸引更多用戶。問題在於，每家公司都是按自己有望勝出的前提興建資料中心，加總起來，整個產業就可能蓋得太多。
這場競賽的資金來源包括企業現金流、股票與債券發行、私人信貸，以及大型雲端業者和輝達(NVDA-US)等供應商對資料中心開發商提供的擔保。部分建設採租賃方式融資，相關義務要等資料中心完工後才會出現在資產負債表上。光看企業目前帳面上的負債，投資人很難判斷，一旦計畫生變，還有哪些公司有義務出錢。
輝達對晶片未來價值提供的擔保，就是一個例子。若晶片價格大跌，輝達本身的利潤率可能已遭壓縮，卻也可能恰好在此時必須履行擔保。換句話說，開發商最需要這項保障的時候，也可能正是擔保方最難承擔損失的時候。

AI投資若退潮 為何重演金融海嘯的機率仍低

儘管如此，杜德利認為，這波AI融資與金融海嘯前的房貸市場仍有重要差別。當年，許多投資人深信美國房價不會在全國同步下跌，也把獲評AAA級的房貸相關證券視為安全資產。金融機構又以短期借款持有難以迅速變現的長期資產，一旦貸款違約增加、短期資金無法續借，就只能低價拋售，讓資產價格進一步下跌。
如今，市場已普遍討論AI投資過熱的風險，而且多數融資期限較長，更符合資料中心的投資年限。保險公司等長期投資人較有能力等候回收資金，私募基金也往往可以限制投資人贖回，降低業者被迫在市場低點出售資產的可能性。
杜德利主張，監管重點應放在資訊較不透明的非銀行金融機構。他建議明確賦予證券主管機關維護金融穩定的職責，由銀行與證券監管機關共同釐清誰向誰借錢、誰提供擔保，以及什麼情況下必須付款。
他也呼籲檢討會計規範，讓企業更完整揭露已承擔的債務與可能觸發的付款義務。如此一來，投資人才能判斷自己承擔多少風險，以及拿到的報酬是否足以補償。
paras_en: If all planned AI infrastructure is built, total investment could exceed $10 trillion. Former New York Federal Reserve Bank president Bill Dudley noted in a Bloomberg column that, given data‑center depreciation rates, the AI industry may need at least $3 trillion in annual revenue to generate sufficient returns on that investment.

He believes the hype’s fade could spark a sharp stock‑market correction, but the odds of it escalating into a crisis on the scale of 2008 remain low. What’s harder to gauge is who ultimately bears the loss if data centers fail to earn the expected profits.

Seven or eight firms are scrambling to become major AI compute service providers, yet only two or three are likely to emerge as winners. As in the cloud market, larger players can spread costs, retain existing customers and services, and attract more users. The problem is each company builds data centers on the premise that it will win, so the industry as a whole may end up over‑building.

Funding for this race comes from corporate cash flow, equity and bond issuances, private credit, and guarantees from large cloud operators and suppliers such as Nvidia (NVDA-US) to data‑center developers. Some construction is financed through leasing, with related obligations appearing on the balance sheet only after the facilities are completed. Looking solely at companies’ current book‑level debt makes it hard for investors to tell which firms would still be on the hook if plans change.

Nvidia’s guarantee of future chip value is an example. If chip prices plunge, Nvidia’s own profit margins could be squeezed, yet it might be forced to honor the guarantee at that moment. In other words, the developer’s need for protection may coincide with the guarantor’s hardest loss‑bearing situation.

Even so, Dudley sees important differences between today’s AI financing and the pre‑crisis mortgage market. Back then, many investors were convinced U.S. home prices wouldn’t fall nationwide and treated AAA‑rated mortgage‑backed securities as safe assets. Financial institutions held illiquid long‑term assets funded by short‑term borrowing; when defaults rose and short‑term funding dried up, they were forced to sell assets at low prices, pushing prices down further.

Today the market widely discusses the risk of an AI investment bubble, and most financing terms are longer, matching the investment horizon of data centers. Long‑term investors such as insurers are better able to wait for returns, and private‑equity funds can often restrict redemptions, reducing the chance that operators must sell assets at market lows.

Dudley argues that regulatory focus should target non‑bank financial institutions that are less transparent. He recommends explicitly giving securities regulators a mandate to safeguard financial stability, with banks and securities supervisors jointly clarifying who borrows from whom, who provides guarantees, and under what conditions payments must be made.

He also calls for a review of accounting standards to require companies to fully disclose incurred debt and potential payment obligations, so investors can assess their risk exposure and determine whether returns adequately compensate for that risk.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉民主黨若拿下國會 哪些美股最敏感？華爾街點名四大類股
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections: Which U.S. Stocks Are Most Sensitive If Democrats Take Congress? Wall Street Highlights Four Key Sectors
paras: 美國期中選舉投票登場，部分民調與多數預測市場看好民主黨拿下參眾兩院，但華爾街的持股布局尚未充分反映這種結果。據《CNBC》報導，摩根大通估計，若民主黨全面掌控國會，標普500指數周三(4日)可能下跌約0.5%；若共和黨失去眾院、卻守住參院，指數反而有望上漲最多1%。對投資人而言，選舉結果不只牽動大盤，也可能改變AI、國防、醫療與金融股的走勢。

選後美股未必照慣例上漲 今年起點不同

選前民調顯示，民主黨有望奪下眾院，參院則勝負難料；預測市場更偏向民主黨包辦兩院。Wolfe Research美國政策與政治研究主管Tobin Marcus表示，該機構訪查逾百名機構投資人後發現，投資人雖已逐漸接受民主黨可能勝選，卻未明顯押注任何一種結果，部分原因是他們懷疑民調高估了民主黨的實力。
富國銀行投資研究所認為，若共和黨守住兩院，政策走向較容易預判，美股短線可望反彈。花旗則看好另一種結果：即使民主黨贏得眾院，只要共和黨保住參院，兩黨分掌國會也可能有利於美股年底行情。
歷史經驗對多頭有利。自1980年代初以來，每次期中選舉結束一年後，標普500指數都高於選舉時的水準。不過，BTIG首席技術分析師Jonathan Krinsky指出，歷來期中選舉年，標普500指數在下半年一度自高點回落的幅度平均達14%，選前走弱，才替11月反彈創造空間。今年標普500指數在投票前已累積兩位數漲幅，他因此認為，這次選後下跌的可能性反而較高。

AI股留意德州州長選情 醫療股看補助政策

近來AI股賣壓沉重，若民主黨在更多州取得執政權，投資人可能更擔心資料中心建設面臨限制。除了國會席次，Marcus也點名德州州長選舉。德州是美國資料中心建設重鎮，共和黨籍州長艾 Abbott若意外落敗，可能在短期內衝擊相關股票。高盛則認為，民主黨若掌控國會，可能縮減資料中心的租稅優惠，但無論選舉結果如何，全美暫停興建資料中心的機率都很低。
國防股與醫療股面對的政策前景也不同。富國銀行投資研究所分析師Alex Sagal指出，若民主黨大勝，扣除通膨後的國防支出成長空間可能受限，除非兩黨就同步增加國防與醫療經費達成協議。不過，他對國防業獲利的展望仍是持穩至溫和成長。

醫療股則可能受惠。Marcus預期，民主黨將爭取恢復《平價醫療法》已到期的加碼保費補助，並推動撤回部分針對聯邦醫療補助計畫(Medicaid)的改革。Argent Capital Management投資組合經理Jed Ellerbroek認為，近期醫療股走強，除了資金從AI股轉進，也有投資人在押注民主黨勝選。他關注的個股包括醫院營運商HCA Healthcare(HCA-US)、Tenet Healthcare(THC-US)，以及健康保險商聯合健康(UNH-US)與Centene(CNC-US)。

銀行留意信用卡利率上限 伊朗局勢牽動年底行情

金融股面對的變數，是川普年初曾要求國會將信用卡利率上限訂在10%。當時金融股一度成為標普500表現最差的類股，之後雖有回升，今年來漲幅約3%。Evercore ISI分析師Matthew Aks認為，若民主黨掌控至少一院，為了回應選民對生活成本的關切，可能再次推動信用卡利率上限，爭取川普支持。這也讓銀行業成為少數可能同時面臨兩黨政策壓力的產業。
選舉之外，美國是否在投票結束後擴大對伊朗的軍事行動，也是年底行情的一大變數。原油價格10月上漲逾10%，周一回吐不少漲幅。根據美國汽車協會(AAA)資料，截至周日，全美汽油均價仍達每加侖4.17美元，較去年同期高出近四成。若衝突升級，油價可能在感恩節出遊旺季前再度走高，能源股也可能因此優於大盤。
Evercore ISI提出的悲觀情境有兩項前提：民主黨拿下國會，而且川普在明年1月新一屆國會就任前擴大對伊朗的軍事行動。若兩者同時發生並推升油價，該機構估計，標普500指數到年底可能出現兩位數跌幅，下探6,800點。
paras_en: U.S. midterm elections are underway, and while many polls and most forecasts expect the Democratic Party to win both the House and the Senate, Wall Street’s portfolio allocations have not yet fully reflected that outcome. According to CNBC, JPMorgan estimates that if Democrats gain full control of Congress, the S&P 500 could fall about 0.5% on Wednesday (the 4th); if Republicans lose the House but hold the Senate, the index could instead rise up to 1%. For investors, the election result not only moves the broad market but could also shift the trajectories of AI, defense, healthcare and financial stocks.

Post‑election, U.S. equities may not follow the usual rally because this year’s starting point is different. Pre‑election polls show Democrats likely to capture the House, while the Senate remains uncertain; the market leans toward a Democratic sweep of both chambers. Wolfe Research’s head of U.S. policy and politics, Tobin Marcus, said that after surveying over a hundred institutional investors, they are gradually accepting a possible Democratic win but are not heavily betting on any outcome, partly because they doubt polls overstate Democratic strength.

Wells Fargo’s investment research believes that if Republicans retain both chambers, policy direction will be easier to predict and U.S. stocks could rebound in the short term. Citi, on the other hand, is bullish on a different scenario: even if Democrats win the House, as long as Republicans keep the Senate, a split Congress could still be favorable for the market’s year‑end performance.

Historical experience favors the bulls. Since the early 1980s, the S&P 500 has been higher a year after every midterm election than at election time. However, BTIG chief technical analyst Jonathan Krinsky notes that in past midterm years the index has fallen an average of 14% from its peak in the second half, weakening before the election and creating room for a November rebound. This year the S&P 500 had already logged double‑digit gains before voting, leading him to think a post‑election decline is more likely this time.

AI stocks have been under heavy selling pressure, and if Democrats take control of more states investors may worry about restrictions on data‑center construction. Marcus also singled out the Texas governor’s race. Texas is a hub for U.S. data centers, and a surprise loss by Republican Governor Greg Abbott could temporarily hit related stocks. Goldman Sachs thinks a Democratic‑controlled Congress might trim tax incentives for data centers, but regardless of the outcome the likelihood of a nationwide halt to data‑center builds remains low.

Defense and healthcare stocks face different policy outlooks. Wells Fargo analyst Alex Sagal says that a Democratic landslide could limit real‑after‑inflation growth in defense spending unless both parties agree to boost defense and healthcare budgets together. Nonetheless, he still expects defense earnings to grow modestly to steadily.

Healthcare stocks could benefit. Marcus expects Democrats to push to restore the expired premium subsidies under the Affordable Care Act and roll back parts of recent Medicaid reforms. Argent Capital Management portfolio manager Jed Ellerbroek notes that recent strength in healthcare stocks stems not only from funds rotating out of AI but also from investors betting on a Democratic win. He watches hospital operators HCA Healthcare (HCA‑US), Tenet Healthcare (THC‑US), and insurers UnitedHealth (UNH‑US) and Centene (CNC‑US).

Bank stocks are watching the credit‑card interest‑rate cap and the Iran situation as year‑end drivers. A variable for financials is that former President Trump earlier this year asked Congress to set a 10% ceiling on credit‑card rates. Financials briefly became the worst‑performing S&P 500 sector, later recovering and gaining about 3% this year. Evercore ISI analyst Matthew Aks says that if Democrats control at least one chamber, they may revive the cap to address voter concerns about living costs, courting Trump’s support. This makes banks one of the few sectors facing pressure from both parties.

Beyond the election, whether the U.S. expands military action against Iran after the vote is another year‑end market variable. Crude prices rose more than 10% in October before retreating on Monday. According to the American Automobile Association (AAA), as of Sunday the national average gasoline price was $4.17 per gallon, nearly 40% higher than a year ago. If the conflict escalates, oil could climb again before the Thanksgiving travel season, giving energy stocks an edge over the broader market.

Evercore ISI’s pessimistic scenario rests on two premises: Democrats win Congress and Trump expands military action against Iran before the new Congress convenes in January. If both occur and push oil higher, the firm estimates the S&P 500 could suffer a double‑digit decline by year‑end, slipping to around 6,800 points.

items.title: 9月飛機訂單大增近三成！美國工廠接單連三月成長
items.title_en: September Aircraft Orders Surge Nearly 30% as U.S. Factory Orders Grow for Third Consecutive Month
paras: 美國9月工廠訂單月增1.8%，優於市場預估的1.2%，連續第三個月成長。波動較大的民航機及零件訂單大增28.3%，是推升整體數據的主要動力。不過，即使扣除運輸設備，工廠訂單仍月增1.3%，機械、電腦與電子產品接單均有成長，顯示需求也延伸至航空業以外的製造部門。
美國商務部人口普查局周二(3日)公布，9月經季節調整後的工廠新訂單增加122億美元，達6,772億美元，8月增幅則由0.1%上修至0.3%。以未經季節調整的數據計算，9月訂單金額較去年同月增加約10.8%，今年前九個月累計較去年同期成長7.2%。
其中，耐久財訂單月增1.9%，高於初估的1.8%，以運輸設備訂單增加4.6%貢獻最大。相較於飛機訂單大增，汽車車身、零件及拖車訂單僅增加0.1%。其他產業方面，機械訂單月增1.5%，電腦與電子產品增加0.8%，電氣設備、家電及零組件則減少0.3%。非耐久財訂單也較前月增加1.8%。
企業設備投資也有回溫跡象。用來觀察企業設備支出計畫的核心資本財訂單，也就是扣除飛機的非國防資本財訂單，9月增幅由初估的0.5%上修至0.6%；這類設備的出貨額則月增1.2%，與初估一致。
據《路透》報導，AI基礎設施投資與強韌的消費支出，持續支撐美國製造業，該產業約占美國經濟的9.4%。不過，接單增加之際，業者對前景仍有顧慮。美國供應管理協會(ISM)周一公布的調查顯示，10月工廠生產強勁，但製造商信心持續惡化，業者點名價格波動、交期拉長、關稅，以及美國與以色列對伊朗的戰事，都是經營壓力來源。
經濟學家提醒，隨著利率走高，家庭所得扣除通膨後也在下滑，明年製造業活動可能放緩，尤其是較少受惠於AI投資的產業。
paras_en: U.S. factory orders rose 1.8% month‑over‑month in September, beating the market’s 1.2% forecast and marking a third straight month of growth. Orders for civil aircraft and parts, which are highly volatile, jumped 28.3%, driving the overall increase. Even after stripping out transportation equipment, factory orders were still up 1.3% month‑over‑month, with machinery, computer and electronic product orders all rising, indicating demand extending beyond the aviation sector into other manufacturing segments.

The U.S. Census Bureau of the Commerce Department announced on Tuesday (the 3rd) that seasonally adjusted new factory orders in September increased by $12.2 billion to $677.2 billion, with August’s growth revised from 0.1% to 0.3%. On a non‑seasonally adjusted basis, September’s order value was about 10.8% higher than the same month last year, and the cumulative total for the first nine months of this year was 7.2% above the comparable period a year earlier.

Durable‑goods orders rose 1.9% month‑over‑month, above the initial estimate of 1.8%, led by a 4.6% increase in transportation equipment orders. While aircraft orders surged, orders for automobile bodies, parts and trailers edged up only 0.1%. In other sectors, machinery orders grew 1.5%, computers and electronic products rose 0.8%, and electrical equipment, household appliances and components fell 0.3%. Non‑durable‑goods orders also rose 1.8% from the prior month.

Business equipment investment is showing signs of a rebound. Core capital‑goods orders – the metric used to gauge corporate equipment‑spending plans and which excludes aircraft and defense capital goods – were revised up to a 0.6% increase in September from the initial 0.5% estimate; shipments of this equipment class rose 1.2% month‑over‑month, in line with the original forecast.

According to Reuters, AI‑related infrastructure spending and resilient consumer demand continue to underpin U.S. manufacturing, which accounts for roughly 9.4% of the U.S. economy. However, despite the order uptick, firms remain cautious about the outlook. A survey released by the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) on Monday showed strong factory production in October, but manufacturer confidence kept deteriorating, with respondents citing price volatility, longer lead times, tariffs and the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran as sources of pressure.

Economists warn that as interest rates stay high, real household incomes are slipping after inflation, which could dampen manufacturing activity next year, especially in sectors that are less likely to benefit from AI investment.

items.title: 美天然氣業者Williams跨足發電 年底前再公布電力專案
items.title_en: US Natural Gas Company Williams Expands into Power Generation, Plans Additional Power Projects by Year‑End
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國天然氣基礎設施業者Williams(WMB-US)正從天然氣輸送延伸至發電業務。公司在法說會表示，預計年底前再公布1至2項電力專案，並預期未來合約年期將拉長，持續擴大資料中心供電布局。
Williams原本以天然氣輸送、儲存與處理為核心業務，隨著資料中心用電需求增加，公司也開始參與發電專案，將業務從供應燃料延伸至供應電力。公司表示，選舉預料不會延誤資料中心專案，相關供電計畫持續推進。

items.title: 美股藏著「隱形熊市」？標普500距高點僅3% 六成成分股卻跌了至少兩成
items.title_en: Is a "Hidden Bear Market" Lurking in US Stocks? S&P 500 Only 3% From Its Peak, Yet 60% of Its Components Have Fallen At Least 20%
paras: 標普500指數距離歷史高點僅約3%，但高盛集團(GS-US)交易員Bobby Molavi指出，指數內已有六成成分股自各自高點下跌至少20%，進入熊市區間。他形容，美股正經歷一場「隱形熊市」。尤其令他意外的是，砸重金興建AI基礎設施的科技巨頭，與承接這些訂單的供應商，股價竟然一起下跌。
據《彭博》報導，主管高盛歐洲、中東與非洲交易執行業務的Molavi在客戶報告中指出，市場普遍仍相信AI將改變各行各業，卻同時下修買方與供應商的估值。自10月15日以來，美股「七巨頭」合計市值已蒸發4兆美元。在他的印象中，這是這些公司首度交出財報後，投資人仍普遍覺得成績不夠好。
不過，過去一個月，多數標普500成分股其實仍有上漲。這與六成個股身處熊市並不矛盾：前者看的是近一個月的漲跌，後者衡量的是股價距各自高點有多遠。隨著資金撤出原本集中的AI股，轉向防禦型類股及先前較少人持有的股票，部分個股雖然反彈，距高點仍遠。
這波資金輪動在上周四尤其明顯。當天，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)股價創20年來最大跌幅，單日市值蒸發5,000億美元，但醫療保健、房地產及民生必需品類股撐盤，標普500指數僅跌0.3%。晶片股承受的賣壓則重得多，費城半導體指數上周五收跌7%，一年來首度跌破200日均線，預估本益比降至約16倍，回到這波AI行情的低點附近。
Molavi認為，從最新財報來看，雲端需求依然強勁。Google Cloud營收翻倍，微軟(MSFT-US)旗下Azure成長48%，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下AWS營收也成長39%，創五年來最快增速。投資人真正想知道的是，科技巨頭還得花多少錢，以及這些投資要多久才能帶來回報。
據Molavi統計，四大科技業者合計創造的自由現金流只剩260億美元，遠低於以往水準。為了支應AI建設，企業除了動用手中現金，也愈來愈依賴發債與股權籌資。以亞馬遜為例，短短九個月，長期債務就從660億美元增至1,730億美元。Molavi認為，上周財報季顯示，市場對AI投資的評價標準已經改變：投資人更在意企業花出去的錢何時能賺回來。
在他眼中，債市傳出的警訊更值得留意。據其統計，自1996年以來，B級與信用評等更低的CCC級債券之間，殖利率差距達到8個百分點的情況不到五次。過去每次出現這個訊號，標普500指數當時都已較52周高點低至少11.5%，其中兩次更接近低了三成。這一次，在同樣的利差訊號出現時，標普500指數進入上周前距高點卻不到2%。
paras_en: The S&P 500 index is just about 3% shy of its historical high, but Goldman Sachs trader Bobby Molavi said that roughly 60% of its constituents have each dropped at least 20% from their own peaks, putting them in bear‑market territory. He described the US equity market as undergoing a "hidden bear market," noting that even the tech giants pouring massive capital into AI infrastructure and the suppliers fulfilling those orders have seen their shares fall together.

According to Bloomberg, Molavi, who heads Goldman’s Europe, Middle East and Africa trading execution business, wrote in a client report that the market still broadly believes AI will transform every industry, yet valuations for both buyers and suppliers have been trimmed. Since October 15, the combined market cap of the US “big‑seven” tech firms has evaporated $4 trillion. In his view, this is the first time after these companies reported earnings that investors generally felt the results were still underwhelming.

However, over the past month most S&P 500 components have actually risen. This does not contradict the fact that 60% of stocks are in a bear market: the former looks at one‑month price moves, while the latter measures how far a stock is from its own peak. As money has fled the once‑concentrated AI stocks and shifted toward defensive sectors and previously less‑held shares, some stocks have rebounded but remain far from their highs.

The rotation was especially evident last Thursday. On that day Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US), Google’s parent, posted its biggest one‑day drop in 20 years, wiping out $500 billion in market value, while healthcare, real estate and consumer‑staples stocks provided support and the S&P 500 fell only 0.3%. Semiconductor stocks faced far heavier selling; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 7% on Friday, breaking below its 200‑day moving average for the first time in a year and seeing its forward P/E fall to roughly 16×, back near the low point of the AI rally.

Molavi believes that, based on the latest earnings, cloud demand remains robust. Google Cloud revenue doubled, Microsoft’s Azure grew 48%, and Amazon’s AWS revenue rose 39%, the fastest five‑year pace. Investors really want to know how much more the tech giants will have to spend and how long it will take for those investments to pay off.

Molavi’s calculations show that the four major tech firms together generated only $26 billion of free cash flow, far below historic levels. To fund AI build‑outs, companies are not only tapping cash on hand but increasingly turning to debt and equity issuance. For Amazon, long‑term debt jumped from $66 billion to $173 billion in just nine months. Molavi says the latest earnings season indicates that the market’s criteria for valuing AI investment have shifted: investors care more about when the money spent will be earned back.

In his view, warning signs from the bond market deserve even more attention. Since 1996, the spread between B‑rated and lower‑rated CCC bonds has widened to 8 percentage points fewer than five times. Each time that signal appeared in the past, the S&P 500 was already at least 11.5% below its 52‑week high, with two instances seeing a drop of about 30%. This time, when the same spread signal emerged, the S&P 500 was less than 2% away from its recent peak.

items.title: 中國央行調高外匯存準率至6%！在岸、離岸人民幣聞訊跳水 兌美元雙雙貶逾0.22%
items.title_en: China's Central Bank Raises FX Reserve Requirement Ratio to 6% – Onshore and Offshore RMB Plunge, Both Falling Over 0.22% Against the Dollar
paras: 中國在岸、離岸人民幣今(3)日兌美元雙雙貶值。截至當日9時35分，在岸人民幣兌美元匯率報6.6632，日內貶值0.23%，離岸人民幣匯率報6.6617，日內貶值0.22%，因為中國央行為加強金融機構外匯流動性管理，自今年11月15日起，上調金融機構外匯存款準備率2個百分點，即外匯存款準備率由現行的4%提高到6%。
此前，中國央行曾在關於人民幣匯率的政策立場中強調，向前看，影響人民幣匯率的因素較為多元，推動升值和貶值的因素都存在，匯率走向還有不確定性。
市場分析師認為，提高外匯存款準備率相當於在外匯市場上收緊了美元的供給和流動性，從而可以減輕人民幣升值的壓力，有助於人民幣對美元匯率保持合理均衡水平上的基本穩定。
今年以來，人民幣大幅升值，離岸人民幣兌美元走升約4.5%。今日，人民幣兌美元中間價調貶4個基點，報6.715，前一交易日中間價報6.7146。
paras_en: Onshore and offshore Chinese yuan both depreciated against the U.S. dollar today (the 3rd). As of 9:35 a.m. local time, the onshore yuan was at 6.6632 per dollar, down 0.23% intraday, while the offshore yuan was at 6.6617 per dollar, down 0.22% intraday. The move follows the People’s Bank of China’s decision to tighten foreign‑exchange liquidity management for financial institutions by raising the foreign‑exchange deposit reserve ratio by two percentage points, from the current 4% to 6%, effective November 15 of this year.

Previously, the PBOC emphasized in its policy stance on the yuan that looking ahead, the factors influencing the exchange rate are diverse, with forces pushing both appreciation and depreciation, making the future direction of the yuan uncertain.

Market analysts say that raising the FX deposit reserve ratio effectively tightens the supply and liquidity of dollars in the foreign‑exchange market, which can ease upward pressure on the yuan and help keep the yuan‑dollar rate at a reasonably balanced, fundamentally stable level.

Since the start of the year, the yuan has appreciated sharply, with offshore yuan gaining about 4.5% against the dollar. Today the central parity rate for the yuan was lowered by four basis points to 6.715, compared with 6.7146 in the previous trading session.

items.title: 日本央行鎖定12月升息 但中性利率的不確定性令前景蒙上陰影
items.title_en: BOJ Targets December Rate Hike, but Uncertainty Around the Neutral Rate Casts a Shadow Over the Outlook
paras: 日本央行在最新政策會議中，將政策利率維持在 1.25% 左右，並強調，基調性通膨已大致符合 2% 的物價目標。隨著市場普遍預測日銀 12 月將再次升息至 1.5%，但投資者仍懷疑，在升息至接近中性利率後，日銀會最終將利率帶向何處。
日銀於 10 月底公布的《經濟與物價情勢展望》報告全文中透露，在評估金融環境時，除了名目與實質利率外，無法直接控制的股市與匯率動態也具顯著影響。
針對利率走向與金融環境，日本央行總裁植田和男表示，10 月決定暫緩升息是為了「再多觀察一點」經濟與物價情勢，但委員會將持續聚焦物價上行風險，高機率於 12 月將政策利率調升至 1.5%。
植田指出，雖然整體金融條件仍屬寬鬆，但已注意到部分中小企業的融資條件出現趨緊跡象，日銀將密切關注該狀況是否進一步擴散。
前日銀官員、樂天證券經濟研究所首席經濟學家愛宕伸康分析，從日銀近期釋出的訊息來看，12 月升息「幾乎已成定局」。他進一步指出，明年的政策路徑較不確定，因為若隨後再次升息將使利率達到 1.75%，這可能已接近被視為對經濟中立的水準。
InvestingLive 分析師Justin Low指出，日銀報告將 2027 財年核心通膨預期上調至 2.6%，顯示通膨壓力持續累積；日銀目前雖仍在評估過去升息對金融環境的傳導效果，但遲早需要以實際行動回應市場，以維護市場對其政策方向與決心的信心。
根據日銀幕僚估算，日本的名目中立利率約落在 1.1% 至 2.5% 之間。然而，由於中立利率無法直接觀測，且日本經歷長達30年的通縮環境，企業與家計部門對借貸成本上升極為敏感。日銀在推進政策正常化的過程中，必須在防止通膨過熱與維持經濟復甦之間謹慎平衡。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan kept its policy rate around 1.25% at its latest policy meeting and stressed that underlying inflation is broadly in line with its 2% price target. While markets widely expect another hike to 1.5% in December, investors still doubt where the BOJ will ultimately steer rates after they reach near‑neutral levels.

In the full text of the October‑end Economic and Price Outlook report, the BOJ disclosed that when assessing the financial environment it looks not only at nominal and real rates but also at stock‑market and exchange‑rate dynamics, which it cannot control directly, and that these have a significant impact.

Regarding the rate trajectory and financial conditions, BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said the decision in October to pause hikes was to “observe a bit more” the economy and price situation, but the board will continue to focus on upward price risks and is highly likely to raise the policy rate to 1.5% in December.

Ueda noted that although overall financial conditions remain accommodative, the BOJ has observed tightening signs in financing conditions for some small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises and will closely monitor whether this spreads further.

Former BOJ official and chief economist at Rakuten Securities’ Economic Research Institute, Nobuyuki Atago, analyzed that, based on the BOJ’s recent messaging, a December hike is “almost a done deal.” He added that the policy path for next year is more uncertain because a further hike could push rates to 1.75%, which may be close to a neutral level for the economy.

InvestingLive analyst Justin Low pointed out that the BOJ’s report raised its FY2027 core‑inflation outlook to 2.6%, indicating that inflation pressures are still building. While the BOJ is still evaluating the transmission effects of past hikes on the financial environment, it will eventually need to act decisively to reassure the market of its policy direction and resolve.

According to BOJ staff estimates, Japan’s nominal neutral rate lies roughly between 1.1% and 2.5%. Because the neutral rate cannot be observed directly and Japan has endured three decades of deflation, firms and households are highly sensitive to higher borrowing costs. In normalising policy, the BOJ must carefully balance preventing inflation from overheating with sustaining the economic recovery.

paras: 美國期中選舉將於當地時間週二(3日)(台灣時間週三)登場，外電最新報導指出，面對民主黨可能奪回國會控制權的風險，白宮已提前數月制定應變備案，研究透過行政命令推進核心政策，並築起法律防線應對國會調查。
《路透社》報導，今年4月起，白宮副幕僚長米勒、預算管理辦公室主任沃特等官員便與法律顧問辦公室合作，整理總統無需國會批准即可採取的行政措施，涵蓋移民、關稅、住房及聯邦支出，法律顧問沙夫(Will Scharf)則在評估法律邊界，研究如何為可能面臨法庭挑戰的決定辯護。川普已聽取彙報，知情人士稱他對「單幹」執政「非常適應」。
具體方案包括對關鍵礦產和風力渦輪機加徵關稅、緊縮國際學生與外勞簽證，以及降低住房成本。各機構已提交法律審查。沃特還計畫修改撥款規則，賦予政治任命官員更大資金分配權，減少對國會撥款的依賴。
目前共和黨在國會僅握微弱多數，民主黨則必須在兩院分別淨增四席即可翻轉。最新民調顯示，民主黨有望贏得眾議院。此前，川普曾稱大選若失利將成為「否決先生」，先否決民主黨法案再尋求妥協。自2025年重返白宮以來，他已多次測試總統權力邊界，包括全面加徵關稅、加強移民執法。
然而，民主黨控制國會後仍有反制手段。參議院民主黨可阻撓司法與行政官員提名；在立法層面，雖然川普否決權難被推翻，但若行政措施越權，法院可介入叫停。白宮已打算向司法部徵求意見，明確行動範圍及訴訟應對策略。
相較於立法僵局，白宮更直接的挑戰是國會調查。眾議院民主黨已準備在奪回控制權後，透過聽證會與傳票，調查川普是否利用職權謀利。
報導指出，白宮律師已開始向官員簡報應對問詢與傳票的技巧，並建議謹慎處理工作記錄，白宮還試圖援引「行政特權」，保護總統與私人顧問的溝通免受審查。
無論選舉結果如何，川普政府正兩手準備：一方面力保國會多數，另一方面則準備在失去優勢後，依靠行政命令與既有撥款強推政策，並迎戰國會調查。行政權與立法權的對決，將在選後持續上演。
paras_en: The U.S. midterm elections will be held on Tuesday, March 3 local time (Wednesday in Taiwan). International reports say that, fearing the Democrats could retake control of Congress, the White House has been preparing contingency plans for months, studying how to push core policies through executive orders and building a legal shield against congressional investigations.

Reuters reported that since April, White House Deputy Chief of Staff Miller, Office of Management and Budget director Whitaker and other officials have been working with the Office of Legal Counsel to compile a list of presidential actions that do not require congressional approval, covering immigration, tariffs, housing and federal spending. Legal counsel Will Scharf is assessing the legal boundaries and figuring out how to defend decisions that may face court challenges. Trump has been briefed and insiders say he is very comfortable with a ‘go‑solo’ style of governing.

Specific proposals include imposing tariffs on critical minerals and wind turbines, tightening visas for international students and foreign workers, and lowering housing costs. All agencies have submitted the measures for legal review. Whitaker also plans to amend appropriations rules to give politically appointed officials greater discretion over fund allocation, reducing reliance on congressional appropriations.

The Republicans currently hold a slim majority in Congress, while Democrats need a net gain of four seats in each chamber to flip control. The latest polls show Democrats are poised to win the House. Previously, Trump said that if he loses the election he will become a ‘veto president,’ first vetoing Democratic bills and then seeking compromise. Since returning to the White House in 2025, he has repeatedly tested the limits of presidential power, including sweeping tariff hikes and tougher immigration enforcement.

However, Democrats would still have checks if they gain control of Congress. Senate Democrats could block judicial and executive nominations; legislatively, although Trump’s veto power is hard to overturn, courts could step in to stop executive actions that exceed authority. The White House plans to seek guidance from the Justice Department on the scope of actions and litigation strategies.

Compared with legislative gridlock, the White House’s more direct challenge is congressional investigations. House Democrats are preparing, once they regain control, to use hearings and subpoenas to investigate whether Trump used his office for personal gain.

Reports say White House lawyers have begun briefing officials on how to handle inquiries and subpoenas, advising careful handling of work records. The administration is also trying to invoke “executive privilege” to shield communications between the president and private advisers from scrutiny.

Regardless of the election outcome, the Trump administration is preparing on two fronts: protecting its congressional majority while also readying to push policies through executive orders and existing appropriations if it loses its advantage, and to fight congressional investigations. The showdown between executive and legislative power will continue after the vote.

paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國經濟第三季以一年來最快速增長、消費者支出強勁及企業加大人工智能(AI)投資，幫助經濟頂住油價上漲衝擊，但龐大AI支出恐無法帶來足夠回報，同時全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安可能遇創紀錄黑客攻擊，引發投資人湧向避險資產，可是資金未流入美元；此外，上週五日本9月公布零售銷售較上年同期減至2.3%，但失業率降至2.4%、求才求職比升至1.19及工業生產較前月增2.2%皆優於預期，而且東京10月核心消費者物價指數(CPI)與剔除生鮮食品及燃料的核心-核心CPI均較去年同期漲2.6%，遠高於日本央行(BOJ)的2%目標，鞏固繼續升息的理由，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自157.89高點走低。

隨後BOJ以八比一決議維持短期政策利率目標在1.25%，但上修通貨膨脹預期，並宣布持續近十四年、旨在實現物價目標的努力取得勝利，亦釋放警惕通貨膨脹風險訊號，暗示最早12月加息，更意外從明年1月起加快出售交易所交易基金(ETF)，進一步推升日圓，並據作為衡量勞動力成本最廣泛指標的美國就業成本指數(ECI)第三季漲0.8%，表明工資通貨膨脹溫和，而且美國十年期公債收益率創2023年12月以來最大單月跌幅，打擊美元兌日圓至156.94低點，但里奇蒙聯邦儲備銀行總裁巴爾金、達拉斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁洛根及聖路易聯邦儲備銀行總裁穆薩萊姆相繼呼籲繼續升息，而且擔憂伊朗局勢升級，扶助美元兌日圓回升。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於157.80-158.00，支撐於156.80-157.00。
◆EUR/USD

上週五澳洲公布第三季生產者物價指數(PPI)較前季降至1.1%，而且科技巨頭鉅額現金消耗引發股市暴跌，一度拖累作為全球風險指標貨幣的澳幣，但得益於澳洲央行(RBA)政策制定者的鷹派言論，令市場預期RBA本周將宣布今年第五次升息，並據紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)助理總裁西爾克稱，若當前經濟情況持續，將支持12月加息，支撐澳幣和紐元，而且消息人士透露，歐洲央行(ECB)預計12月升息，帶動歐元兌美元升至1.1214高點。
據ECB管理委員會委員帕內塔稱要再升息遏制通貨膨脹，而且第三季國內生產總值(GDP)初值，歐元區分別較前季與上年同期升0.4%及1.3%高於預期，但法國較前季萎縮0.1%，而且德國10月CPI與消費者物價調和指數(HICP)較去年同期皆降至2.8%，打壓歐元兌美元至1.1136低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1160-80，支撐於1.1070-90。
◆GBP/USD

英國財政大臣希利上周首份預算案未使英鎊或英國公債價格出現大幅波動的意外，貨幣市場則完全消化英國央行(BOE)本周加息的預期，而且法國動盪持續拖累歐元兌英鎊跌至十八個月低點，提振英鎊兌美元至1.3433高點。隨後全英房屋抵押貸款協會月度數據顯示英國10月房屋價格較上年同期放緩至2024年1月以來最低達0.5%，衝擊英鎊兌美元跌至1.3370低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3400-20，支撐於1.3310-30。

The U.S. economy grew at the fastest pace in a year in Q3, with strong consumer spending and firms increasing AI investment, helping the economy withstand higher oil prices. However, massive AI spending may not generate sufficient returns, and the world’s largest crypto exchange Binance may face a record‑breaking hack, prompting investors to flee to safe‑haven assets—yet funds have not flowed into the dollar. In addition, Japan’s September retail sales fell 2.3% year‑on‑year, but unemployment dropped to 2.4%, the job‑vacancy ratio rose to 1.19, and industrial production rose 2.2% month‑on‑month, all better than expected. Tokyo’s October core CPI and core‑core CPI (excluding fresh food and fuel) were up 2.6% YoY, far above the BOJ’s 2% target, reinforcing the case for further rate hikes and boosting the yen, while USD/JPY fell from the 157.89 high.

The BOJ then voted 8‑1 to keep the short‑term policy rate target at 1.25% but raised its inflation outlook and announced that its nearly 14‑year effort to achieve the price goal had succeeded, while also warning of inflation risks. It hinted at a possible rate hike as early as December and unexpectedly said it would accelerate ETF sales starting January 2025, further supporting the yen. Meanwhile, the U.S. Employment Cost Index rose 0.8% in Q3, indicating modest wage‑price inflation, and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield posted its biggest monthly drop since December 2023, pushing USD/JPY down to a low of 156.94. Nevertheless, Richmond Fed President Barkin, Dallas Fed President Logan and St. Louis Fed President Mussa‑Lem called for continued tightening, and concerns over an escalation in Iran raised the dollar again. Today's USD/JPY resistance is estimated at 157.80‑158.00, support at 156.80‑157.00.
EUR/USD

Last Friday Australia reported its Q3 producer price index fell to 1.1% YoY, and large cash burn by tech giants triggered a stock market plunge that temporarily weighed on the Aussie dollar, a global risk‑currency benchmark. However, hawkish comments from RBA policymakers have led the market to expect the RBA to announce its fifth rate hike of the year this week. According to RBNZ Assistant Governor Silk, if current conditions persist, a December hike is supported, bolstering both the Aussie and the kiwi. Sources also say the ECB is expected to raise rates in December, pushing EUR/USD up to a high of 1.1214.

ECB Governing Council member Panetta said further hikes are needed to curb inflation. Preliminary Q3 GDP figures showed the euro area grew 0.4% QoQ and 1.3% YoY, beating expectations, although France contracted 0.1% QoQ. Germany’s October CPI and HICP both fell to 2.8% YoY, pulling EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1136. Today's EUR/USD resistance is estimated at 1.1160‑1.1180, support at 1.1070‑1.1090.

Subsequently, the UK Mortgage Association’s monthly data showed October house prices slowed to a 0.5% YoY decline—the weakest since January 2024—pressuring GBP/USD down to a low of 1.3370. items.title: 期中選舉倒數2天！美加貿易談判現轉機　川普：協議已有雛型 加總理：不會趕在選前簽
items.title_en: Midterm Election Countdown: US-Canada Trade Talks See a Breakthrough; Trump: Agreement Already Has a Draft, Canadian PM: No Rush to Sign Before Election
paras: 美國期中大選倒數2天之際，美加貿易談判出現轉機。美國總統川普與加拿大總理卡尼周日(1日)先後表示，雙方已就新貿易協議形成「初步構想」，團隊未來數週將續推細節，但具體條款與簽署時程仍未曝光。
川普周日在愛荷華州表示，前一天再度與卡尼通話，「我們已有協議概念」，聲稱方案有利美國農民與整體利益，但未披露關稅減免等關鍵內容。卡尼也在X平台上發文呼應稱雙方延續「建設性討論」，協議須創造就業、緩解家庭成本，並「充分尊重加國語言、文化與主權」。
美加兩國正磋商下調美對加鋼鐵、汽車關稅的可能性，但未必是全面協議，較可能是擱置部分分歧的「有限安排」。雙方談判曾於8月破裂。當時加國拒絕美國要求，包括削弱法語保護、限制加國與他國簽貿易協定等，卡尼批評相關要求觸碰主權紅線。隨後華府對約200億美元加拿大商品加徵50%關稅，渥太華以報復性關稅反制，衝擊鋼鐵、汽車及跨境製造業，關稅戰也成為密西根等邊境州選戰焦點。
卡尼強調，不會為趕在選前簽約而接受不利加國的條件。他日前受訪時表示，若條款符合加國利益可快速達陣，否則寧可不簽。
與此同時，加拿大加速分散對美依賴。上周加歐峰會宣佈推進供應鏈、國防與關鍵礦產合作，卡尼設定未來十年對美以外市場出口倍增目標。
分析人士指出，美加雙方雖重啟接觸，但鋼鋁汽車關稅、中重型車免稅範圍及主權保障仍是未解鴻溝；在正式文本出爐前，市場宜審慎解讀「初步構想」的分量。
paras_en: With the US midterm election just two days away, a breakthrough has emerged in US‑Canada trade negotiations. President Donald Trump and Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau both said on Sunday (the 1st) that the two sides have formed a “preliminary concept” for a new trade agreement, and their teams will continue to work out details over the next few weeks, though specific provisions and a signing timetable have not been disclosed.

Trump told reporters in Iowa on Sunday that after a phone call with Trudeau the day before, “we have an agreement concept,” claiming the proposal benefits American farmers and the broader economy, but he did not reveal key elements such as tariff cuts. Trudeau echoed the sentiment on X, saying the two sides are maintaining “constructive discussions,” that any deal must create jobs, ease household costs, and “fully respect Canada’s language, culture and sovereignty.”

The United States and Canada are discussing the possibility of lowering US tariffs on Canadian steel and automobiles, but the outcome may not be a comprehensive pact; it is more likely to be a limited arrangement that shelves some disputes. Negotiations collapsed in August when Canada rejected US demands that would have weakened French‑language protections and limited Canada’s ability to sign trade deals with other countries, a move Trudeau called a breach of Canada’s sovereign red line. Washington then imposed a 50 % tariff on about $20 billion of Canadian goods, prompting Ottawa to retaliate with its own tariffs, hitting steel, autos and cross‑border manufacturing. The tariff war has also become a focal point in the election battles in border states such as Michigan.

Trudeau stressed that Canada will not accept any terms that are disadvantageous simply to get a deal signed before the election. He said in a recent interview that if the provisions meet Canada’s interests, a swift agreement is possible; otherwise, Canada would rather walk away than sign a bad deal.

At the same time, Canada is accelerating efforts to diversify away from reliance on the United States. At last week’s Canada‑EU summit, the two sides announced plans to deepen cooperation on supply chains, defence and critical minerals, and Trudeau set a target to double Canada’s exports to markets outside the United States over the next ten years.

Analysts note that although the United States and Canada have resumed contact, major gaps remain over steel, aluminium and auto tariffs, the scope of duty‑free treatment for medium‑heavy vehicles, and sovereignty safeguards. Until a formal text is released, markets should interpret the “preliminary concept” cautiously.
